jobs.title: SAP Inhouse Consultant FICO
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

Join our IT Team in Madrid as SAP Inhouse Consultant Finance & Controlling to work on SAP projects and to support our SAP ERP platforms in your area of expertise.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Facilitating, coordinating and contributing to feasibility studies

• Understanding business processes and business requirements and creating functional specifications for implementation

• Responsible for system build, thus hands on configuration skills are required

• Responsible for solution design and contributing to harmonization initiatives

• Incident and request resolution

• Contributing actively to problem management and challenging incidents or change requests on the strategic SAP platforms

• Providing or assisting with training of (key) users

• Preparing test cases and test scripts and carrying out the integration testing as a part of the project delivery

• Maintaining user and system documentation and incorporating changes as needed / appropriate

• Keeping up to date with industrywide trends and best practices (both process and technology)

• Ensure proper rollout / implementation of ERP roll-out projects for your area of responsibility

• Identify and manage actions related to communication, training, master data management, etc. arising from and in connection with projects, both within and outside the IT community

• Project management of the finance related projects

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in technical or business studies, further training in SAP or equivalent experience

• A strong portfolio of experience with SAP Finance and Controlling as a consultant, especially in Product Costing and Profitability Analysis

• Experience in SAP Finance components: Fixed Assets, Banking, Accounts Receivables, Credit Control Management, Accounts Payables, Statutory, Indirect Tax and IFRS Reporting

• Experience in Month and Year End closing and reporting. Knowledge of Schedule Manager or Closing Cockpit is a plus.

• Knowhow from the manufacturing industry is a plus

• Experience from two or more successful SAP rollouts where you handled finance projects as your specialist area

• Knowhow in customizing finance modules, and understanding integration with other modules like SD and MM

• Good process understanding and ability to be able to support SAP best practice approaches within different templates

• Experience with Basware is considered an advantage

• Strong communication skills in English.

• Excellent collaboration, internal consulting and facilitation skills

• Ability to learn new technologies and processes quickly and to adapt to changes in timelines and sequences

• Readiness to travel (25 %)

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant Tickets

• Permanent contract

• Accident insurance

• Central workplace in Nuevos Ministerios

•

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: OTC Billing Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

We are looking for an OTC Billing Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Order to Cash processes to the next level. As a Billing Analyst, you will collaborate with multiple Sulzer Legal Entities and engage with diverse stakeholders, including Project Managers, Finance Heads, the CoE Accounting Manager, the Reporting and Analytics team, and external customers.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on service agreements and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in billing details and compliance with contractual terms

• Closely collaborate with the local Project Manager

• Review and reconcile billing data for completeness and accuracy, making necessary adjustments or corrections

• Ensure timely invoice dispatch to third-party customers in line with customer requirements, complying with local regulations (e.g., B2B e-invoicing).

• Collaborate with sales, customer service, the cash collections team, and project management teams to gather necessary information for billing, and to resolve any billing-related issues and queries.

• Maintain and update customer billing information and records in the billing system

• Perform AR, Revenue & Aging analysis

• Support the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and account reconciliations related to billing

• Generate and analyze billing reports, providing insights and recommendations to improve the billing process and reduce errors. Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team on this

• Ensure compliance with OTC internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements related to billing operations

• Participate in the implementation and improvement of billing systems and procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy, in cooperation with the OTC GPO.

• Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and addressing auditor inquiries related to billing

• Support the intercompany billing process.

• Support definition and preparation of KPIs in the billing area.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.

• Minimum of 2 of experience in billing in a similar role.

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred.

• Strong understanding of the Order to Cash cycle.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition and billing process

• Proficiency in interpreting billing reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. Senior Billing Accountants, CoE Accounting Manager, Reporting & Analytics team and Country Finance Heads

• Experience in Global Business Services or Finance Shared Services organizations will be highly valued.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala) highly valued.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Fluency in English; additional European languages are a plus.

• Great communication skills. Continuous interaction with project teams and other stakeholders is critical to succeed in this role.

• Proactive mindset, ready to contribute to create the new teams we are building up in our Center of Excellence.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of

jobs.title: Constructiewerker Rotorshop Mechanic (BBL opleiding)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Technician is responsible for fabricating, installing, calibrating, testing, and repairing mechanical equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Kom werken bij het Sulzer Turbo Services, onderdeel van Sulzer Services, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde onafhankelijke aanbieders van reparatie, revisie en onderhoud binnen de turbine-industrie. Vanuit Venlo (Lomm) of op locatie, bieden wij onze klanten wereldwijd solide, klantgerichte en flexibele ondersteuning voor hun compressoren, stoom- en gasturbines. Sluit je aan bij onze trotse en hoogopgeleide internationale crew als Constructiewerker Rotorshop Mechanic (BBL opleiding).

Je werkt 4 dagen per week op onze locatie in Lomm en 1 dag per week ga je naar school.

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Nauwkeurige demontage/inspectie/probleemoplossing/reparatie/montage van diverse roterende apparatuur (gasturbines, stoomturbines en compressoren) volgens Sulzer-specificaties
• Gebruik van handgereedschap, hydraulische spanapparatuur, takels, krikken, winkelhaken, linialen, micrometers, schietloden en speciaal gereedschap voor de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden

Om in deze functie te slagen, moet je:
• Een proactieve houding hebben en leergierig zijn
• Teamplayer zijn die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische wereld en graag het werk van een rotorshop mechanic wilt leren
• Flexibel zijn en open houding hebben

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

We are looking for a/an Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist (French / German Speaker) to join our GF_Finance & Controlling, Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Accounts Receivable area to the next level.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Taking action to achieve AR overdue reduction in the legal entities (LEs) under your responsibility.
• Proactively following-up the collections process for assigned customer accounts, including communications with customers by phone and email to ensure payments are made complying with agreed contract conditions.
• Identifying and resolving disputes impacting customer payments, coordinating with relevant stakeholders for a quick issue resolution.
• Defining together with CoE Team Leader efficient collection strategies, ensuring compliance with Sulzer Collection Guideline and an efficient prioritization of customer contacts to optimize overdue results.
• Following-up on LE overdue results, supporting with KPI calculation and maintaining accurate accounts receivable files and records.
• Actively participating in meetings with LE stakeholders, proposing actions to correct deviations and escalating AR-related issues when required.
• Cooperating in the migration of new customers and LE’s to the scope of the CoE in Madrid.
• Supporting in standardization of AR collection-related processes across the group.
• Acting as a subject-matter expert (SME) for Sulzer in AR Collections area, identifying and sharing best practices across the Group and providing guidance to stakeholders to improve Group collection results.
• Identifying improvement opportunities related to collections activities, working closely with Legal Entity stakeholders and CoE Team Leader looking for efficiencies and best practices in the area.
• Credit risk analysis and credit rating assessment of customers based on external credit risk management tools and reports.
• Defining and recommending credit limits in line with Sulzer internal policies and standards.
• Ongoing monitoring, reporting and escalation of credit exposure.
• Dealing with customers and work closely with Sales Team and local Finance stakeholders as part of the credit management process.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Financial background with good understanding of OTC processes.
• Fluency in English is a must. German, French, Italian or any other European language will be an advantage.
• Some experience working in Cash Collections, or Accounts receivable in Financial Shared Services organization is a plus.
• SAP & FSCM (Collection and Disputes) experience is also a plus.
• Results oriented.
• Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to identify when issues need to be escalated.
• Excel

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Under limited supervision, performs all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications / Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Interpret drawings and advise purchaser regarding the sequence of steps in erection, installation, inspection, start-up, or repair of pumps. Explain features and components of products and the functions of those products, and constructively comment on work conditions, methods, and procedures at the jobsite. Key Responsibilities

• Supervise/assist in troubleshooting of problems, installation, assembly or disassembly of pumps, and/or seals

• Travel to jobsites worldwide upon dispatching by Field Service Manager

• Responsible for completing and forwarding to corporate office all necessary paperwork for all jobs

• Inform closest Service Center of any potential sales activities while at site

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• Experience in pump factory or Service Center with skills in different work processes of pump manufacturing, assembly, or testing—Sulzer Apprenticeship Program meets these requirements

• Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and listening skills

• Strong ability to utilize technical knowledge and analytical skills to resolve problems and customer complaints

• Excellent interpersonal skills

• Strong computer skills, with proficiency in latest “Microsoft” software. SAP and Gelco expense reporting a plus.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain.
This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid.
If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Any other European language is a plus

• Analytical and problem solving skills

What we offer you

What we offer you:
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer Energy&Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a/an Senior Sales Engineer Energy&Infrastructure to join our t eam in Spain .

Join our team and be part of a company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. As a Sales Engineer, you will play a key role in driving our business forward by connecting technical expertise with customer needs, helping us expand our market presence and deliver exceptional value to our clients. Your contributions will directly impact our success and shape the future of our organization.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Acting as main contact for all sales related activities for certain customers in the territory as specified by the Sales Director for the area of responsibility

• Support the management with the development plan and support the establishment of annual sales budgets, timely monthly RFCs and Company’s sales objectives

• Attendance of sales meetings, ensuring that all relevant information from assigned area is available to the Management as required

• Ensure that SULZER’s CRM system is updated on a regular basis

• Assure profitable growth in the sales territory

• Create and maintain close customer relationships

• Review, manage and interpret customer enquiry documents and specifications, support overall tender process

• Coordinate with customers for resolution of technical and commercial queries

• Liaise effectively with our global network of manufacturing plants to ensure we provide the best offering and service to our clients

• Negotiate and closing sales by agreeing terms and conditions

• Conduct the Project until it is handed over to the different Sulzer factories

• Facilitate communication between Spanish clients and Sulzer factories during project execution

• Continuous monitoring of changing Market Segments, target customers, & Competition

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• University degree in Mechanical Engineering

• A minimum of 5 years relevant experience in related industries, especially in Oil&Gas Business

• Familiar with API standards

• Customer orientation, communication, negotiation and relationship management skills at any level of the customer base

• Self-motivated, self-organized and naturally driven to succeed in a competitive environment

• Fully fluent in English and Spanish is a must

• Availability for travelling in Spain and abroad

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to changes

• Being a creative thinker

What we offer you

• A permanent contract

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team

• A good vibe working environment.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: IT Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.
Sulzer Chemtech liefert weltweit hochpräzise Komponenten und Systeme für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Unsere Logistik- und Einkaufsabteilung sorgt dafür, dass die richtigen Materialien zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind – effizient, kostengünstig und nachhaltig.
Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der industriellen Lieferketten. Ihre Aufgaben

• 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung (Client- und Mobile-Device-Management)

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Hyper-V-Infrastruktur in Zusammenarbeit mit dem zentralen Rechenzentrumsteam und der lokalen IT an den Standorten Bruchsal und Bonn

• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung der regulatorischen Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie (Backup und Wiederherstellung mit Commvault, B2D und B2T)

• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierte Verkabelung

• Verantwortung für die Dokumentation von Systemkonfigurationen und Änderungen

• Lokale IT-Business-Partnerschaft für die Fachbereiche

• Aktive Teilnahme und Unterstützung von Unternehmensinitiativen

• Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams, z. B. Client-Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit bei entsprechender Eignung möglich

Ihr Profil

• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)

• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sprachen:
• Deutsch: mind. A2

• Englisch: B2 oder höher

• Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil

• Soft Skills:
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Lösungs- und kostenorientiertes Arbeiten

• Zuverlässigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Flexibilität

• Sie wissen sich in einer arbeitsteiligen Konzernumgebung zu bewegen

What we offer you

Wir bieten

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen.

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.en: Service technician (f/m/d) pump technology in field service

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser.

Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen.
In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort

• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort

• Störungsanalysen

• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)

• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)

• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil

• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel

• Führerschein Klasse B

• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen)

What we offer you

Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.

• Zukunftssichere Position in einem modernen und wachsenden Unternehmen

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Leistungsgerechte Vergütung, inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• Intensive Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Einsatzmöglichkeit vom Wohnort

• Top ausgestattete Service-Vans mit modernem Werkzeug

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsmechaniker Rotating Equipment (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Fluid-Engineering mit Hauptsitz in Winterthur, Schweiz. Seit 1834 entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen für das Pumpen, Mischen und Trennen von Flüssigkeiten. Mit rund 13.800 Mitarbeitenden und über 180 Standorten weltweit stehen wir für Qualität, Kundennähe und technische Exzellenz.

Unsere Services
An über 100 Servicestandorten bietet Sulzer umfassende Wartungs-, Reparatur- und Ersatzteillösungen für Pumpen, Turbinen, Kompressoren und andere rotierende Maschinen – herstellerunabhängig. Unsere technologiebasierten Services sorgen für maximale Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg – direkt bei unseren Kunden vor Ort. Ihre Aufgaben

• Reparatur, Wartung, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme von Pumpen, Kompressoren, Getrieben, Turbinen und weiteren rotierenden Maschinen

• Analyse und Bewertung von Schadensfällen sowie Störungsbeseitigung

• Selbstständige Demontage und Montage von Equipment und Aggregaten inkl. Gleitringdichtung und Peripherie

• Durchführung von Instandhaltungsarbeiten nach Zeichnung oder technischen Vorgaben

• Dokumentation aller Arbeitsprozesse, Erstellung von Berichten und Befundaufnahmen

• Sicherstellung der hohen Qualitätsstandards von Sulzer

• Technische Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Industriemechaniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Service von Rotating Equipment (Pumpen, Kompressoren, Turbinen etc.)

• Idealerweise Erfahrung in Branchen wie Petrochemie, Chemie, Raffinerie oder Energieerzeugung

• Reisebereitschaft für Tages- und gelegentliche Mehrtagesmontagen

• Flexibilität für kurzfristige Einsätze und Mehrarbeit

• Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting

• Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Gültiger PKW-Führerschein (Kran-/Staplerschein und SCC-Zertifizierung von Vorteil)

What we offer you

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und spannende Aufgaben in einem renommierten Unternehmen

• Attraktive Vergütung nach Metall- und Elektro-Tarifvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells

• Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• Familiäres Arbeitsumfeld mit internationaler Konzernanbindung

• Individuelle Weiterentwicklung durch interne und externe Schulungen

• Lebensarbeitszeitkonten mit attraktiver Förderung

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und MetallRente

• Krankenzusatzversicherung mit Unternehmenszuschuss

• Bezuschusstes Betriebsrestaurant, gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und ÖPNV-Zuschuss

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Zerspanungsmechaniker (m/w/d) / Dreher (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Mécanicien de coupe (m/w/d) / machine à tourner (m/w/d)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sie suchen als Zerspanungsmechaniker die technische Herausforderung und möchten Ihre Fachkunde in einer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit einbringen? Sie möchten Teil eines gut aufgestellten Teams werden, in dem Sie auch zukunftsorientierte Perspektiven haben? Dann sind Sie richtig in unserem Service Center am Standort Schwarze Pumpe: unser erfahrenes Team mit ca. 30 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern sind Teil unseres Service Center Netzwerks in Deutschland. Wir bieten unseren Kunden technisch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für ihre Einsatzbereiche. Darüber hinaus gehört die präventive Wartung, Instandhaltung und Reparatur von Pumpen, Armaturen und Turbinen sowie anderen rotierenden Maschinen sowohl für Sulzer als auch für Produkte anderer Hersteller zu unserem Leistungsspektrum.

In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

Als Zerspanungsmechaniker sind Sie zuständig für die eigenständige Bearbeitung verschiedenster Bauteile an CNC-gesteuerten und konventionellen Zerspanungsmaschinen. Im Bereich CNC-Drehtechnik arbeiten Sie an Dreh- und Fräsmaschinen mit Siemens-Steuerung. An konventionellen Maschinen werden Arbeiten an Bohrwerken und Drehmaschinen mit Spitzenweite von bis zu 4500 mm durchgeführt. Dabei können Sie auch auf einen breit gefächerten Maschinenpark und tatkräftige Unterstützung durch das bestehende Team zurückgreifen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört unter anderem:

• Einzelbearbeitung von Bauteilen nach Zeichnung

• Eigenständiges Ermitteln von Bearbeitungswerten unter Berücksichtigung von Werkstoffdaten

• Beim Schwerpunkt CNC-Drehtechnik: komplett eigenständiges Erstellen von CNC-Programmen (Zyklensteuerung)

• Selbständiges Rüsten und Aufspannen der Maschine bzw. der Bauteile

• Bedienung der Zerspanungsmaschinen

• Prüfung der gefertigten Bauteile im Rahmen der Werker-Selbstkontrolle

• Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Bearbeitungsprozessen

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
Sie passen gut bei uns ins Team, wenn Sie neben dem notwendigen technischen Geschick auch die richtige Einstellung mitbringen: aufgrund der hohen Anforderungen unseres Service-Geschäfts sind uns hierbei ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, eine genaue und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, sowie Flexibilität hinsichtlich Aufgaben besonders wichtig. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie noch folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Zerspanungsmechaniker oder gleichwertige Ausbildung / Erfahrung

• Idealerweise mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung

• Kranführer-Schein von Vorteil (ansonsten: Bereitschaft / Eignung zur Ausbildung nach Eintritt)

What we offer you

Mit unserem an den Metall- und Elektro-Tarifvertrag angelehnten Haustarifvertrag bieten wir eine adäquate Vergütung auf Basis einer 37,5-Stunden Woche, sowie zahlreiche Sozialleistungen.
Es erwarten Sie zum Beispiel:

• Betriebliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in modernem Neubau ab 2023

• Familiäres Arbeitsumfeld vor Ort bei gleichzeitig internationaler Anbindung im Konzernverbund

• Unterstützung der individuellen Entwicklung durch gezielte in- und externe Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen

• Lebensarbeitszeitkonten mit attraktiver Förderung durch das Unternehmen

• Betriebsrente sowie zusätzliche Möglichkeit zur Nutzung der individuellen Bruttoentgeltumwandlung der MetallRente

• Krankenzusatzversicherung mit Bezuschussung durch das Unternehmen

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Dann sind Sie richtig in unserem Service Center am Standort Schwarze Pumpe: unser erfahrenes Team mit ca. 30 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern sind Teil unseres Service Center Netzwerks in Deutschland. Wir bieten unseren Kunden technisch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für ihre Einsatzbereiche. Darüber hinaus gehört die präventive Wartung, Instandhaltung und Reparatur von Pumpen, Armaturen und Turbinen sowie anderen rotierenden Maschinen sowohl für Sulzer als auch für Produkte anderer Hersteller zu unserem Leistungsspektrum. In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für: Als Zerspanungsmechaniker sind Sie zuständig für die eigenständige Bearbeitung verschiedenster Bauteile an CNC-gesteuerten und konventionellen Zerspanungsmaschinen. titleByLocale.fr: Apprentis technicien mécatronique (m/f/d) Début de la formation 2026

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Bei Sulzer unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Entwicklung nicht nur durch Lernprogramme, sondern auch durch Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten am Arbeitsplatz. Innovation ist seit Beginn in unserer Unternehmensgeschichte verwurzelt. Werde Teil unserer Geschichte, erweitere dein Fachwissen und hilf uns dabei Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger gestalten.

Für den Ausbildungsbeginn im August 2026 suchen wir am Standort Spremberg einen Auszubildenden Mechatroniker (m/w/d). Deine Aufgaben:

• Komplexe, mechatronische Systeme aus mechanischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Bestandteilen bauen

• Montage und Instandhaltung von Maschinen, Anlagen und Systemen

• Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik und Elektronik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik

• Installieren elektrischer Anlagen und Baugruppen

• Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung in mechatronischen Systemen

• Installieren, Testen und Nutzen von PC-Hard- und Software

Dein Profil:

• Mindestens Fachoberschulreife (FOR) bzw. Realschulabschluss

• Einen guten Wissensstand in Mathematik und Physik

• Handwerkliches Geschick, technisches Verständnis und Ausdauer
Als erfahrener Ausbildungsbetrieb gestalten wir die Ausbildung mit starkem Praxisbezug, moderner Technik sowie individuellen Förderungsmöglichkeiten.

What we offer you

Die Berufsausbildung bei Sulzer Pumpen ist ein Start in ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit hervorragenden Perspektiven. Die Auszubildenden profitieren von:

• Moderner Technik

• Engagierten Ausbildern

• Professioneller Betreuung

• Motivierendem Arbeitsklima

• den individuellen Möglichkeiten nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Ausbildung

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SAP Data Migration Consultant

titleByLocale.fr: Conseiller en migration de données SAP

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for Data Migration process for all phases including extraction, transformation, loading. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Group organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
1. Responsible for Data Migration process for all phases including extraction, transformation, loading.
2. Oversee overall data cleansing to provide project reports, but this role can monitor the stats and help escalate when we're falling behind
3. Support with legacy system extracts and data analysis on an ad hoc basis.
4. Cleansing activities including, Support and guidance to business users, support all reporting needs, data profiles.
5. Managing, monitoring of all data cleansing activities including, support and guidance to business users, support all reporting needs, data profiles.
6. Ensuring all milestones and deliverables are met in each migration phase from Data Profiling, Extraction, Transformation and Load until Go-Live
7. Accountable for delivering successful test load and production load including sign-off and verification from the business owners
8. Accountable and responsible for developing risk matrix and mitigation plan.
9. Planning and tracking the plan delivery in area of data cleansing tasks.
10. Managing the load progress (test migrations and production upload) tracking data defects and issues in a structured way ensuring the resolution of the high importance ticket items
11. Tracking & implementing lessons learned systematically
12. Training of the project team on the data migration approach and framework used that everyone in the project organization understands the process
13. Ensure proper documentation for the migration requirements, relevancy rules, value mapping, field mappings.
14. Require travel depending on projects needs
15. Facilitate connecting project team with additional business SMEs for SAP processes related questions
16. Responsible for Data Migration Workstream phases deliverables (Activate Methodology):
17. Prepare: Legacy Data Audit. Migration Approach and Strategy
18. Realize: Data Load in QAS. Preliminary Cutover. Legacy Data Migration (Develop Data Migration Programs and Manual Data Migration processes. Data Quality reporting. Target Load Tests. Final Data Quality Assessment)

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Offering Manager Catalysts & Solvents
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Process Solutions team and play a central part in the success of our licensed technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader to manage and grow our global aftermarket business. This business supplies essential solvents and catalysts to our customers in the refining, petrochemical, biofuels, and chemical recycling sectors.

This role is key to providing our customers with valuable, long-term solutions. You will be responsible for the success of this business line, shaping its strategy and driving its growth.

The role can be based in a number of locations: Winterthur/Allschwil, Singapore, Shanghai, Houston, or fully remote. Key roles and contributions:

• Define and execute a winning strategy for our solvent and catalyst business, creating synergy with Sulzer's licensed technologies.

• Make our product offerings stronger through smart pricing, effective market positioning, and good supplier partnerships.

• Oversee our solvent and catalyst products from development to end-of-life, including driving new innovations.

• Work closely with our technology and process solution teams to increase aftermarket sales.

• Keep track of industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities for business growth.

• Collaborate across departments to ensure our products and services meet customer needs.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, or a similar field.

• 10-15 years of experience in the refining, petrochemical, or chemical processing industries.

• A strong background in selling catalysts, solvents, or other industrial chemicals to these markets.

• Proven success in growing an aftermarket business for industrial products.

• A good understanding of process technologies, product portfolio management, and how solvents and catalysts are used.

• Experience with extraction technologies (such as BTX extraction) is a major plus.

• Excellent skills in strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and leadership.

• Fluency in English is required. Other languages are an asset.

What we offer you

• Attractive compensation and vacation plan

• Excellent social benefits

• Global development opportunities

• A collaborative, diverse and innovation-driven culture

• Employee Assistance Program

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Sales Engineer is responsible for providing technical expertise and support throughout the sales process, from initial customer engagement to post-sale implementation. This role involves analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations. The Sr. Sales Engineer ensures that solutions are technically sound and aligned with customer needs.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

Key 
• Responsibilities

Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for proposed solutions.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ensure feasibility.
Support sales teams with technical documentation and proposals.
Troubleshoot implementation issues and provide training to users.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and technologies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
At Sulzer Falkirk, we’re the High Voltage Service Centre of Excellence, delivering world-class solutions for motor and generator repairs, upgrades, and maintenance. We’re looking for a Field Service Engineer to join our expert team, working remotely while supporting customers across onshore and offshore sites in power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors.. Job Responsibilities

• Investigate, dismantle, test, and overhaul LV & HV motors, pumps, and rotating equipment at customer sites.

• Carry out rewinds and mechanical repairs using advanced tools and techniques.

• Record build tolerances, complete accurate job documentation, and maintain high standards of quality.

• Build strong relationships with customers, ensuring satisfaction and trust.

• Champion safety, environmental responsibility, and continuous improvement.

Job Qualifications

• Electrical/Mechanical engineering apprenticeship or equivalent experience in rotating machinery.

• Proven track record in repairing LV, HV, DC motors and other rotating equipment.

• Ability to read mechanical drawings, strong attention to detail, and practical problem-solving.

• Adaptable, organised, and able to work independently or as part of a team.

• Knowledge of health and safety requirements.

• Full and valid licence preferred

• BOSIET certification preferred

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• An annual bonus based on company performance

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse
.

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As part of the Global IT organization, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining and monitoring Sulzer global network services Key responsabilities:

1. Network Administration & Operations:

• Design, configure, maintain, and upgrade network infrastructure (LAN, WAN, VPN, firewalls, switches, routers).

• Implement network segmentation, VLANs, and routing protocols for optimal performance.

• Monitor network health, set up alerts, and proactively troubleshoot latency or connectivity issues.

• Ensure high availability and redundancy through proper failover and disaster recovery strategies.

• Maintain accurate network diagrams and documentation for compliance and operational efficiency.

2. Vulnerability Management:

• Identify and assess network-related security vulnerabilities using industry-standard tools.

• Prioritize remediation efforts, apply patches, and validate fixes to maintain compliance with security policies.

• Collaborate with security teams to enforce network hardening and access control measures.

3. Support:

• Provide Level 2/3 support for complex network issues and escalations.

• Take ownership of critical incidents, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis. Maintain detailed troubleshooting guides and knowledge base for network operations.

4. Project & Continuous Improvement:

• Lead or contribute to network infrastructure projects, including upgrades and new deployments.

• Perform testing and validation for new network implementations to ensure stability and compliance.

• Drive automation and optimization initiatives to improve network efficiency and reduce downtime.

You need to succeed:

• 3–5 years of experience managing Global Network Services, including LAN/WAN/WiFi environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science

• Strong technical background in global network services, network automation, and security‑driven projects (e.g., LAN/WAN segmentation).

• Proactive, flexible, reliable, and solution‑oriented mindset.

• Strong analytical abilities and effective communication skills.

• Team‑oriented with the ability to work independently when needed.

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits.

International applicants are welcome to apply. No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - Sustainable Fuels

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur régional des ventes - Carburants durables

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking to grow our licensed technology portfolio business in our existing markets as well as by bringing in new technologies that serve emerging growth segments, with a specific focus on growing the sustainable fuels and oleochemicals segments.

Achieving our growth objectives requires a strong sales force that is focused on identifying and delivering new opportunities in a changing world as well as a strong local execution team. The ideal candidate has relevant sales experience in technology solutions and is passionate about winning, leadership, and results. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Develop a business plan for the area of responsibility with a focus on increasing market share and identifying new opportunities for Sulzer GTC; monitor and report progress regularly.

• Work closely with business segment leaders to develop business in assigned area of responsibility and assure accurate forecast for order intake. Share market feedback toward business segment leaders to further develop the technology portfolio. Carry out market research, analysis, and sales forecasting and gather competitive intelligence and provide market feedback and technology requirements to technology managers.

• Identify and develop new business opportunities including a leading involvement in the sales and pricing strategy while leading the risk assessment process.

• Support clients in creating new unplanned projects through early engagement with them to understand needs and develop responding value propositions.

• Establish strong relationships with other business groups in Sulzer to identify additional opportunities for increased collaboration across the complete solution portfolio.

• Issue commercial proposal, incorporate commercial terms in agreements and structure deals with customers in close cooperation with business segment leaders

• In consultation with other team members, determine the sales strategy for individual proposals and assure adequate staffing of the proposal effort is in place.

• Closely review contract terms and conditions and coordinate reviews with the legal and financial department. Lead the negotiations of agreements with customers by coordinating with legal and other internal functions.

• Coordinate with the technical services team to identify and deliver growth opportunities in aftermarket sales.

• Prepare commercial offers and give client presentations for technology sales.

• Ensures compliance with company policies and enforce all standards set for performance.

• Support implementation and correct usage of forecasting tools.

Educational background & professional experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Process or Chemical engineering preferred

• Professional sales experience in a similar business environment or a technology license type business

• Knowledge of refinery and petrochemical industries.

• Knowledge of renewable fuels and/or plastics recycling industries.

Personal strengths

• Successful in building, maintaining and enlarging customer relationship

• Self-motivator who drives for results and closing deals with strategic commercial insight

• Strong analytical skills to identify trends and sales patterns and adapt strategy and tactics accordingly

• Excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills

• Ability to operate at all levels, externally and internally

• Ability to handle high pressure situations

• Ability to collaborate in and work well with a team

Other requirements

• Fluent in English, other languages are a plus

• Readiness to travel within area of responsibility and internationally

What we offer you

Insurance
Dental
22 Days Paid AL
14 Days Paid MC

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a div

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.

Basic Function:

He will be responsible to manufacture structural steel and platework, heavy machinery, other fabricated metal products. Welding & Fitting components for final assembly.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

· Perform daily Inspections and maintenance of Personal Protective Equipment and Welding Machines including cables, Welding torch etc. as per Schedule.
· Read and interpret blueprints or welding process specifications
· Operate manually welding equipment to fuse metal segments using processes primarily TIG and some experience with: (OAW), (GTAW), (GMAW) (MIG)
· Repair worn parts of metal products by welding on extra layers
· Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing and soldering equipment
· adjusting welding heads and tooling according to work specifications
· Perform Self-Inspection of parts and work to print
· Complete and maintain paperwork.

• Check machine for defects and repair if necessary

• Ensure machine is calibrated and cleaned

• Lift work piece manually, by forklift or by overhead crane, positions and secures against guides and stops.

• Maintains a clean work area, including his equipment, work supplies and materials

• Complies with Federal, State, and local occupational safety, environmental, health and Safety and air pollution control regulations including machine safety with all safety precautions recommended by Machine manufacturers.

• Adhere to Sulzer safety standards of facility and actively participate in the company’s Safe Behavioral Program & Take 5.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

Experience, Education & Skills:

• Required: 2-3 years’ experience in use of metal fabrication or related work comparable experience in other fields

• Desired:

• High School Degree or GED

• Completion of a three-year apprenticeship program

• Ability to set-up and run machinery without supervision

• Understand and follow oral and written instructions

• Forklift or Crane license considered an asset

• Trade certification is required

• Ability to read and interpret production and sales orders.

• Experience in safe use, storage and disposal of Welding rods & cleaning the work area etc.

• Knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local laws, codes and regulations pertaining to occupational safety, health, and air pollution control.

• Experienced in using power and hand tools

• Meticulous and detail oriented

• Able to lift 50 pounds unassisted

• Able to work independently

• Highly self-motivated

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Vendas
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student, Apprentice, or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. Principais Responsabilidades
• Suportar a elaboração propostas técnicas e comerciais para fornecimento de peças sobressalentes e reparos em equipamentos rotativos de acordo com a necessidade do cliente
• Cadastro da oferta no sistema SAP
• Atualização de processos no CRM Salesforce
• Acompanhar time de vendas externas em visitas a clientes
• Trabalhar em conjunto ao time de BI (Business Intellince) em dashboard no Salesforce, treinamento time de vendas externas e mapeamento oportunidades negócios
• Auxiliar elaboração de relatórios com volumes de vendas por território vs linha de produto para a gestão vendas - avaliação performance e indicadores vendas

Habilidades Necessárias
• Conhecimento em interpretação de desenhos técnicos
• Excel Avançado
• Inglês Intermediário/Avançado

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Refeição no local
• Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. jobs.title: Engineer Rotating Equipment (Shop)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as an Engineer Rotating Equipment (Shop). In this role you will be accountable for:

•
• Inspection & repair activities on rotating equipment in our local workshop

•
• Reverse engineering processes of rotating equipment parts

•
• The repairs, operations, and maintenance of rotating equipment in general

•
• The developments on rotating equipment related services and products

•
• The support of field service activities in a back-office role

•
• Advice and support to other departments e.g. sales, tendering as well as external customers

To succeed in this role, you will need:

•
• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering

•
• 5 years’ experience in rotating equipment engineering

•
• Very good English language skills

•
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude

•
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

What we offer you

•
• A more than competitive salary

•
• A generous number of holidays (40)

•
• A solid pension scheme

•
• Training opportunities

•
• Company restaurant at the facility with tasty and healthy options

•
• Bicycle plan, company fitness, and more

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our team within as an Electrical Fitter in our Laverton North Service Centre.

• Repair and maintain LV & HV electrical rotating machinery.

• Assemble and disassemble electrical rotating equipment.

• Conduct static and dynamic tests on electrical equipment to ensure optimal performance.

• Rewind electric motors and generators.

• Perform balancing on motors to keep things running smoothly.

• Keep the goods flowing with timely ordering when required.

• Take direction from your Supervisor to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.

• When required, attend onsite to conduct effective repairs of electrical rotating equipment.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• CERT III in Electrotechnology or above / equivalent.

• Experience in repairing and rewinding DC motors, medium to High Voltage electrical motors, and generators.

• Excellent time management skills to keep things on track.

• Strong teamwork skills.

• Dedication to maintaining a safe work environment at all times.

What we offer you

• Variety of work at service centre location and field work

• Site allowances for field work

• Technical training and development

• On-site car parking

• Employee Assistance Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer PPR
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Technical Buyer PPR is responsible for purchase goods, materials and services through proper and fair negotiations to ensure that the projects’ needs are met, taking into consideration price, quality and lead times, according to Sulzer policies. Description of the specific tasks

• Adhere to Sulzer policies and procedures regarding the purchase of Products and Services and in accordance with the finance department procedures applicable to Procurement

• Assume responsibility for leading the procurement of assigned project materials, products and services within budget and within project timescales.

• Establish working relationships with vendors to strengthen business and support company strategies.

• Keep contact with all related suppliers to evaluate the characteristics of the products and services being supplied under the required quality and conditions

• Monitor market trends, competitor strategies and market suppliers

• Explore alternate sources for goods and materials

• Provide the project team with the offers received, making the relevant comments and suggestions about the suppliers, opportunities and market status.

• Prepare technical and commercial evaluation sheets ensuring full scope of supply has been quoted accurately and like throughout panel of vendors

• Gather all relevant requirements from the different departments involved in the project (PM, quality, ORE, …) and host bid clarification meetings with the suppliers involving all stakeholders within the business if required to ensure scope is in line with the needs of the project and company business.

• Responsible for the timely conversion of requisitions to purchase order placement

• Obtain written confirmation of delivery by means of securing formal purchase order acknowledgments for all purchase orders

• Ensure delivery of purchased supplies in accordance with project and production requirements in a timely manner and with the required quality

• Expedite supplier activities as well as internal involved departments to provide the required feedback to enable suppliers to progress with engineering / production activity.

• Manage the timely resolution of Non-Conformities with suppliers and coordinate the internal activities required for their closure.

• Effectively communicate and escalate any risks to delivery dates and production schedule within the business.

• Keep updated the relevant data on the ERP of the factory on the assigned tasks and responsibilities.

• Identify lessons learnt, communicate them to all relevant stakeholders and properly document them according to Sulzer Spain procedures

• Balance both tactical executions with strategic initiatives necessary to drive cost reduction projects.

• Delivers briefs, updates and reports as required and attends required meetings

• Commit to the continuous improvement strategy by developing ideas and strategies to improve operational efficiency, add value, aid business performance and work.

• Assume responsibility for any proposed and assigned actions within any internal improvement project.

• Behavioral demonstration of safety policies commitment and mindset

• Be ethical and compliant with all regulations in place

Skills

• Highly skilled at negotiating.

• Contract management.

• Planning.

• Strong oral and written communication in Spanish and English.

• Willing to assume responsibilities.

• Team player.

• Results oriented.

• Ability to coordinate several projects at a time.

• Problem-solving

• Proactivity in incident resolution

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Bra
