jobs.title: Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer's Brendale Service Centre and bring your expertise in electric motor repairs to our dynamic team. We offer competitive workshop pay, excellent workplace culture, career progression, and long-term job security. Experience in Low and High Voltage electric motor repair and overhauls is essential. As an Electrical Fitter, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and repairing electrical rotating equipment.

Your daily responsibilities will include

• Repairing Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) rotating machinery, with a focus on electric motors and generators.

• Performing full overhauls, rewinds, and conducting static and dynamic testing.

• Disassembling and assembling various electrical rotating equipment.

• Attending client sites for critical repairs and servicing.

• Ensuring work is completed safely and to the highest standard.

What We're Looking For

• A Certificate III in Electrical Fitting (or equivalent).

• Extensive experience in repairing, rewinding, and overhauling electric motors, including DC motors, medium to high-voltage motors, and generators.

• Strong focus on safety and excellent time management skills.

• A customer-first mindset with flexibility and problem-solving capabilities.

What we offer you

• Professional Growth: Access development and cutting-edge technology to elevate your career.

• Competitive Compensation: Attractive hourly rates with clear career progression pathways.

• Job Security: Strong pipeline of projects in mining and power generation.

• Recognition & Rewards: Celebrate success with gift cards, monthly BBQs, and other recognition programs.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: VTL Machine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Summary: Works under limited supervision, sets up and operates machine tools without assistance, following department policy and procedures. Manufactures and reconditions components parts to customer, OEM, and industry standards using conventions, machine tools, including VTL, lathes, milling machines, grinders, etc. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches, and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Constantly measures components, parts and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges and tools.

Essential Functions:

• Sets up and operates conventional machine tools, under limited supervision.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up, including methods of mounting, leveling aligning, holding and fastening work.

• Interprets blueprints, charts, tables, handbook formulas, sketches, and written and verbal orders. Lays out work according to requirements. Selects and grinds own cutting tools.

• Works within close tolerances to meet customer/contract specifications and applies knowledge of qualities of metals and alloys being machined.

• Performs any bench work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications.

• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001.

· Safety obligations:
o All employees understand and are able to explain the structure and objectives of the SBP.
o All employees follow the safety rules.
o All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation.

• Maintains machine tools as required to keep machines in good operating condition.

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.

• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in–process work during or prior to a shift change as required.

• Assis other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experience coworkers.

• Works overtime as required.

• Participates in 5S and housekeeping assignments.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Supervisory Responsibilities:
· None
Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a machine shop operating all types of conventional machine tools including lathes, milling machine, boring machines, and drills.

• Ability to read and interpret standard and metric drawings and blueprints, applying knowledge of tool geometry, feeds, speed and basic math skills.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1

titleByLocale.fr: Service technique d ' appui aux ventes (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Position verantworten Sie die bundesweite Erstellung von Service‑ und Wartungsangeboten in den Segmenten Kommunale Entwässerung sowie Haus‑ und Grundstücksentwässerung. Dabei unterstützen Sie aktiv unsere Mitarbeitenden im technischen Service und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur reibungslosen Abwicklung von Kundenanfragen.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Technische und kaufmännische Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Bestellungen im Serviceumfeld

• Erstellung und Ausarbeitung von kommerziellen und technischen Angeboten für unsere Kunden

• Ermittlung von Lieferzeiten über SAP sowie in Abstimmung mit unseren Zulieferern

• Enge Kommunikation mit internationalen Werken und externen Lieferanten

• Unterstützung und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachabteilungen zur optimalen Angebotsgestaltung

Ihr Profil

Sie überzeugen durch Ihr Engagement, Ihre strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Ihre ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung. Zudem bringen Sie folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung

• Idealerweise erste Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im technischen Kundenservice

• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in stressigen Situationen den Überblick zu behalten

• Teamfähigkeit und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikationsweise

• Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen IT‑Systemen und Anwendungen (z. B. SAP, Salesforce, MS Office)

• Gute Englischkenntnisse, insbesondere im technischen Umfeld

What we offer you

• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld

• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten

• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team

• Marktgerechte Vergütung

• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen

• JobRad‑Leasing

• Kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee & Wasser), Obstkorb und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Engenheiro(a) de Aplicação
Cost Estimation Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Cost Estimation Engineer (m/w/d), der in der Angebots‑ und Projektphase maßgeblich zur Kosten‑ und Wirtschaftlichkeitstransparenz beiträgt. Die Position ist auf Verantwortungsbereiche in kleinen, mittleren und großen Organisationseinheiten ausgelegt und verbindet technisches Know-how mit kaufmännischem Verständnis.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Erstellung von Kosten‑ und Durchlaufzeitkalkulationen für Projekte in der Angebots‑ und Sales‑Phase

• Kostenkalkulation und Bewertung von Blechbauteilen unter Einsatz von Laser­schneiden, Stanzen, Umformen, Biegen und Schweißen

• Analyse technischer Spezifikationen, Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und historischer Daten

• Bewertung von Fertigungstechnologien, Materialeinsatz und Supply‑Strategien hinsichtlich Kosten und Effizienz

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Engineering, Produktion, Einkauf und Logistik zur Kostenoptimierung

• Unterstützung des Vertriebs in enger Abstimmung mit den Engineering‑Teams

• Weiterentwicklung von Kalkulations‑ und Kostenschätzungstools

• Durchführung von Kosten‑, Prozess‑ und Effizienzanalysen zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

• Mitarbeit an globalen Business‑Intelligence‑ und Prozessverbesserungsprojekten (z. B. QlikSense)

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar

• Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cost Engineering, in der Kalkulation oder im Engineering

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in CAD‑ und Simulationstools

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich, Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Fundiertes Verständnis mechanischer Konstruktions‑ und Fertigungsprinzipien

• Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Team‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: ESG Integration Manager, Flow
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group ESG Sr. Analyst is responsible for supporting ESG data management, reporting, and analysis. This role contributes to ESG initiatives by providing insights, tracking performance, and assisting in stakeholder communications.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The ESG Integration Manager plays a central role in integrating sustainability into Flow’s business processes in line with the Corporate ESG strategy. The position leads the deployment of ESG initiatives across Business Units and Legal Entities, supports the achievement of environmental targets, ensures robust ESG data and reporting, and promotes best practices, governance, and compliance. This role actively contributes to building a strong ESG culture across the organization.

Main responsibilities:

• Deploy Flow sustainability roadmap in alignment with Corporate ESG strategy and Flow priorities

• Govern ESG within the division through the Sustainability Council

• Maintain and further develop ESG frameworks and lead implementation efforts

• Report, lead, prioritize, drive, and coordinate the division ESH related actions

• Actively manage ESG KPIs and ensure data integrity and availability

• Meet corporate environmental targets and track improvement projects reviews via project funnel

• Management and administration of the Flow Ideation platform in collaboration with other nominated colleagues and participation in the Flow Innovation Council.

• Propose necessary actions to achieve goal fulfillment and correct deviations

• Support as needed the non-financial reporting preparation

• Develop training material on safety awareness and environmental attention

• Communicate Sustainability targets, best practice and achievements

• Ensure compliance to ISO 14001, stay up to date on ESG regulation and legislation requirements

• Environment: coordinate the actions plans to reduce the environmental load as part of ESG program

What you need to succeed:

• 5+ years of experience in Sustainability / ESG / ESH functions, gained in an in‑house or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to industrial or manufacturing sectors.

• Strong expertise in ESG project management, including sustainability KPIs, frameworks, governance, and reporting; solid understanding of global ESG trends and regulations.

• Proven knowledge of environmental management systems and processes, including ISO 14001 (internal auditor); experience with CSRD‑related data is a plus.

• Degree in Sustainability Management, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, or Business; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification desired; SAP knowledge is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills, fluent in English, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, lead workshops, and work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinist is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior machinists.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our Services team within Rotating Equipment Services division in Ontario as a Journey-person Machinist to help us take Sulzer Rotating Equipment Services (Canada) Ltd., to the next level.

In this role, working under limited supervision, you will:

• Set-up and operate conventional machine tools as directed; Perform layouts

• Read and interpret drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Use proper machining techniques: setup feeds and speeds for both carbide and high-speed steel cutting tools per standard operating procedures and methods

• Manufacture or repair product on time as defined by direct supervisor and production schedule.

• Improve methods for higher quality and improved costs

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Completion of a related apprenticeship program preferred

• Working knowledge and ability to effectively set-up all or most of the following machines: Engine Lathe, Milling Machine, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill

• CNC machine tool experience an asset

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds on alloy materials

• Ability to work overtime as required

If you are qualified with proven expertise in this position, take the next step and make the most of your skills.

What we offer you

• On-site car parking

• Eligible for overtime

• Length of service awards

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Wheel Motor Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer's Brendale Service Centre and bring your expertise in wheel motor repairs to our dynamic team. We offer competitive workshop pay, excellent workplace culture, career progression, and long-term job security.
In this position, you will play a pivotal role in our Wheel Motor Exchange Program. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Overhaul and maintain electric mining haul truck wheel motors and associated equipment.

• Disassemble, inspect, and repair large mechanical assemblies with precision.

• Complete job reports and requisition parts to keep projects on track.

• Replace or repair worn components such as shafts, gears, seals, and bearing fits.

• Clean and prepare mechanical equipment using specialized methods and tools.

• Adhere to QESH standards and promote a safe, clean work environment.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Trade Certificate III Mechanical Fitter/Fitter & Turner/Diesel Mechanic (or equivalent)

• Experience in Mechanical fitting large equipment i.e., Wheel units, gearboxes etc

• Strong focus on safety and excellent time management skills.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative team mindset.

• Current Driver's License (Forklift license and Dogging ticket are a bonus).

What we offer you

• Competitive hourly rate and annual wage reviews.

• Opportunities for overtime to boost your earnings.

• Employee Assistance Program for your wellbeing.

• On-site parking for convenience.

• Be part of a global organisation that values innovation, excellence, and its people.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: Soutien aux ventes – Ventes ENA Services (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Teil unserer Services‑Division unterstützt diese Position die Leitung Sales ENA Services sowie die Leitung Sales DACH durch hochwertige administrative, operative und betriebswirtschaftliche Aufgaben. In dieser Rolle leisten Sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einem reibungslosen Tagesgeschäft, indem Sie die Kommunikation koordinieren, Reportings und Präsentationsunterlagen vorbereiten, Meetings unterstützen und eine präzise Datenpflege in Salesforce sicherstellen. Damit ermöglichen Sie unseren kommerziellen Führungskräften, sich auf strategische Prioritäten zu konzentrieren, und tragen maßgeblich zur Effizienz der ENA‑Services‑Organisation bei. Ihre Aufgaben

• Unterstützung der Vertriebsleitung durch die Koordination von Meetings, inkl. Agendaerstellung, Protokollen und Nachverfolgung offener Punkte

• Pflege von Kalendern, Organisation von Reisen sowie Übernahme administrativer Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft

• Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Zusammenführung von Berichten, Übersichten und Präsentationsunterlagen

• Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität in Salesforce durch Pflege, Aktualisierung und Vollständigkeitsprüfungen für ENA und DACH

• Einholung, Zusammenstellung und strukturierte Aufbereitung von Informationen aus den regionalen Vertriebsteams und Service Centern

• Vorbereitung von Meeting‑Unterlagen sowie rechtzeitige Bereitstellung relevanter Informationen und Materialien

• Unterstützung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Service Centern und weiteren internen Schnittstellen

Ihr Profil

• mind. 3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im kaufmännischen, administrativen oder vertriebsnahen Umfeld

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook

• Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder einem vergleichbaren CRM‑System

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Bachelorabschluss in einem wirtschaftsnahen bzw. administrativen Bereich

• Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Strukturierte, eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Organisations‑ und Priorisierungsfähigkeit

• Proaktive Haltung, hohe Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles Auftreten

• Klare und sichere Kommunikation auf verschiedenen Organisationsebenen

• Hohes Maß an Genauigkeit, Vertraulichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit bereichsübergreifenden Teams

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Führungskräften im kommerziellen Bereich

• Einblicke in internationale Geschäftsthemen, Reporting sowie Vertriebskennzahlen und ‑auswertungen

• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer Kombination aus administrativer Unterstützung, Business Support und Prozesskoordination

• Aktive Mitwirkung an der Effizienzsteigerung innerhalb der Sales‑ENA‑Services‑Organisation

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer's Cardiff Service Centre and bring your expertise in electric motor repairs to our dynamic team. We offer flexible work options, abundant overtime, career progression, and long-term job security. Experience in Low and High Voltage electric motor repair and overhauls is essential. Be part of a global organisation, working on exciting projects across the mining and power generation sectors. 

About the Role:
As an Electrical Fitter, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and repairing electrical rotating equipment. Your daily responsibilities will include:

• Repairing Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) rotating machinery, with a focus on electric motors and generators.

• Performing full overhauls, rewinds, and conducting static and dynamic testing.

• Disassembling and assembling various electrical rotating equipment.

• Attending client sites for critical repairs and servicing.

• Ensuring work is completed safely and to the highest standard.

What We're Looking For

• A Certificate III in Electrical Fitting (or equivalent).

• Extensive experience in repairing, rewinding, and overhauling electric motors, including DC motors, medium to high-voltage motors, and generators.

• Strong focus on safety and excellent time management skills.

• A customer-first mindset with flexibility and problem-solving capabilities.

What we offer you

• Flexible Work Schedule: Enjoy a four-day workweek for better work-life balance.

• Professional Growth: Access training programs and cutting-edge technology to elevate your career.

• Competitive Compensation: Attractive hourly rates with clear career progression pathways.

• Job Security: Strong pipeline of projects in mining and power generation.

• Health & Wellbeing: Participate in wellbeing initiatives and stay fit for the future.

• Recognition & Rewards: Celebrate success with gift cards, monthly BBQs, and other recognition programs.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Advisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Quality Advisor role driving audits, compliance, and continuous improvement across operations. Partner with leaders, strengthen IMS, and influence a strong quality culture at Sulzer. At Sulzer, we don’t just adapt to change, we drive it. With nearly 200 years of innovation and a global footprint spanning 180 facilities, we deliver world-class engineering solutions that keep critical industries moving.

At Sulzer Australia, our teams support essential rotating equipment across power generation, petrochemicals, mining, and heavy manufacturing. Quality isn’t a function here, it’s fundamental to how we operate.

We’re looking for a Quality Advisor who thrives on improving systems, influencing culture, and partnering with operational leaders to lift performance across the business. This role can be based at our Maitland, Cardiff or Brisbane locations.

If you enjoy being in the detail, driving continuous improvement, and making a tangible impact, then this role is for you.

 The Role
This is a hands-on quality role with real influence. You’ll partner closely with operational teams to strengthen compliance, enhance processes, and embed a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
From leading audits to coaching leaders and investigating non-conformances, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our Integrated Management System (IMS) remains effective and aligned with certification requirements.

⚙️ What You’ll Do

• Lead internal audit programs and support external certification audits

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance

• Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions

• Support the ongoing implementation and governance of IMS

• Partner with supervisors and leaders to strengthen quality culture

• Develop and coordinate quality compliance plans and training initiatives

• Ensure documentation and processes align with ISO standards

• Provide practical, value-adding advice to operational teams

✅ About You
You’re pragmatic, detail-oriented, and confident influencing stakeholders at all levels. You don’t just identify problems, you solve them.
You bring:

• Experience in manufacturing, mechanical, or electrical environments

• Strong working knowledge of quality systems and certification standards

• The confidence to engage leaders and challenge the status quo

• Excellent time management and communication skills

• A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement

 Qualifications & Experience

• Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 9001 highly regarded)

• Trade or engineering qualification strongly preferred (electrical is advantageous)

• Experience implementing quality or continuous improvement systems

• Highly desirable: experience in Ex certification (IECEx 60079.19 and AS/NZS 3800) and strong understanding of AC/DC electric motors.

What we offer you

⭐ Performance-based bonus scheme that genuinely rewards impact and results
⭐ Company-provided phone, laptop, and corporate credit card
⭐ Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing
⭐ Highly collaborative environment with strong operational influence
⭐ Part of a global organisation offering long-term career development opportunities

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Quality Advisor role driving audits, compliance, and continuous improvement across operations. Partner with leaders, strengthen IMS, and influence a strong quality culture at Sulzer. At Sulzer, we don’t just adapt to change, we drive it. With nearly 200 years of innovation and a global footprint spanning 180 facilities, we deliver world-class engineering solutions that keep critical industries moving. At Sulzer Australia, our teams support essential rotating equipment across power generation, petrochemicals, mining, and heavy manufacturing. Quality isn’t a function here, it’s fundamental to how we operate. We’re looking for a Quality Advisor who thrives on improving systems, influencing culture, and partnering with operational leaders to lift performance across the business. This role can be based at our Maitland, Cardiff or Brisbane locations. If you enjoy being in the detail, driving continuous improvement, and making a tangible impact, then this role is for you.  The Role This is a hands-on quality role with real influence. You’ll partner closely with operational teams to strengthen compliance, enhance processes, and embed a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. From leading audits to coaching leaders and investigating non-conformances, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our Integrated Management System (IMS) remains effective and aligned with certification requirements. ⚙️ What You’ll Do
• Lead internal audit programs and support external certification audits
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance
• Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions
• Support the ongoing implementation and governance of IMS
• Partner with supervisors and leaders to strengthen quality culture
• Develop and coordinate quality compliance plans and training initiatives
• Ensure documentation and processes align with ISO standards
• Provide practical, value-adding advice to operational teams ✅ About You You’re pragmatic, detail-oriented, and confident influencing stakeholders at all levels. You don’t just identify problems, you solve them. You bring:
• Experience in manufacturing, mechanical, or electrical environments
• Strong working knowledge of quality systems and certification standards
• The confidence to engage leaders and challenge the status quo
• Excellent time management and communication skills
• A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement  Qualifications & Experience
• Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 9001 highly regarded)
• Trade or engineering qualification strongly preferred (electrical is advantageous)
• Experience implementing quality or continuous improvement systems
• Highly desirable: experience in Ex certification (IECEx 60079.19 and AS/NZS 3800) and strong understanding of AC/DC electric motors. What we offer you ⭐ Performance-based bonus scheme that genuinely rewards impact and results ⭐ Company-provided phone, laptop, and corporate credit card ⭐ Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing ⭐ Highly collaborative environment with strong operational influence ⭐ Part of a global organisation offering long-term career development opportunities Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Qualitätsberater Rolle Fahraudits, Compliance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung im gesamten Betrieb. Partner mit Führungskräften, stärken IMS und beeinflussen eine starke Qualitätskultur bei Sulzer. Bei Sulzer passen wir uns nicht nur an Veränderungen an, wir fahren es. Mit fast 200 Jahren Innovation und einem globalen Fußabdruck von über 180 Anlagen bieten wir erstklassige Engineering-Lösungen, die kritische Branchen bewegen. Bei Sulzer Australia unterstützen unsere Teams wesentliche rotierende Geräte über Stromerzeugung, Petrochemie, Bergbau und schwere Fertigung. Qualität ist hier keine Funktion, es ist grundlegend, wie wir arbeiten. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem Qualitätsberater, der sich auf die Verbesserung der Systeme, die Beeinflussung der Kultur und die Zusammenarbeit mit operativen Führungskräften, um die Leistung im gesamten Unternehmen zu erhöhen. Diese Rolle kann an unseren Standorten Maitland, Cardiff oder Brisbane basieren. Wenn Sie es genießen, im Detail zu sein, kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu fahren und eine spürbare Auswirkung zu machen, dann ist diese Rolle für Sie.  Die Rolle Dies ist eine praktische Qualitätsrolle mit echtem Einfluss. Sie werden eng mit operativen Teams zusammenarbeiten, um die Compliance zu stärken, Prozesse zu verbessern und eine Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung einzubetten. Von führenden Audits bis hin zu Coaching-Führern und der Untersuchung von Nicht-Konformanzen spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass unser Integrated Management System (IMS) weiterhin wirksam und mit Zertifizierungsanforderungen konform bleibt. Was Sie tun
• Führen Sie interne Auditprogramme und unterstützen externe Zertifizierungsaudits
• kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen, die die operative Leistungsfähigkeit verbessern
• Untersuchung von Nicht-Konformanzen, Durchführung von Wurzelursachenanalysen und Durchführung von Korrekturmaßnahmen
• Unterstützung der laufenden Umsetzung und Governance von IMS
• Partner mit Supervisoren und Führungskräften zur Stärkung der Qualitätskultur
• Entwicklung und Koordinierung von Qualitätskonformitätsplänen und Ausbildungsinitiativen
• Gewährleistung von Dokumentationen und Prozessen in Übereinstimmung mit ISO-Normen
• Praktische, wertvolle Beratung für operative Teams Über Sie Sie sind pragmatisch, detailorientierte und zuversichtlich beeinflussende Interessenvertreter auf allen Ebenen. Sie identifizieren nicht nur Probleme, Sie lösen sie. Sie bringen:
• Erfahrung in der Herstellung, mechanischen oder elektrischen Umgebung
• Starkes Arbeitswissen über Qualitätssysteme und Zertifizierungsstandards
• Das Vertrauen der Führungskräfte und die Herausforderung des Status quo
• Ausgezeichnete Zeitmanagement- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Eine proaktive Denkweise mit einer Leidenschaft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung  Qualifikationen & Erfahrungen
• Lead Auditor Qualifizierung (ISO 9001 hoch angesehen)
• Handel oder technische Qualifikation stark bevorzugt (elektrisch ist vorteilhaft)
• Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Qualitäts- oder kontinuierlichen Verbesserungssystemen
• Sehr wünschenswert: Erfahrung in der Ex-Zertifizierung (IECEx 60079.19 und AS/NZS 3800) und starkes Verständnis von AC/DC Elektromotoren. Was wir Ihnen anbieten ⭐ Performance-basiertes Bonusprogramm, das tatsächlich Auswirkungen und Ergebnisse belohnt ⭐ Unternehmen bereitgestelltes Telefon, Laptop und Kreditkarte ⭐ Mitarbeiter-Hilfe-Programm zur Unterstützung Ihres Wohlbefindens ⭐ Hochkollaborative Umgebung mit starkem operativem Einfluss ⭐ Teil einer globalen Organisation, die langfristige Karriereentwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind verpflichtet, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld anzubieten. Wir sind stolz, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le rôle de conseiller en qualité est de diriger les vérifications, la conformité et l'amélioration continue des opérations. Partenaire avec des leaders, renforce IMS et influence une culture de qualité forte chez Sulzer. Chez Sulzer, on ne s'adapte pas au changement, on le conduit. Avec près de 200 ans d'innovation et une empreinte mondiale de 180 installations, nous offrons des solutions d'ingénierie de calibre mondial qui maintiennent les industries critiques en mouvement. Chez Sulzer Australia, nos équipes soutiennent les équipements rotatifs essentiels pour la production d'électricité, la pétrochimie, l'exploitation minière et la fabrication lourde. La qualité n'est pas une fonction ici, elle est fondamentale pour notre fonctionnement. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un conseiller en qualité qui prospère dans l'amélioration des systèmes, l'influence de la culture et le partenariat avec les dirigeants opérationnels pour augmenter la performance dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Ce rôle peut être basé sur nos sites de Maitland, Cardiff ou Brisbane. Si vous aimez être dans le détail, conduire l'amélioration continue, et faire un impact tangible, alors ce rôle est pour vous. Le rôle C'est un rôle de qualité pratique avec une réelle influence. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles pour renforcer la conformité, améliorer les processus et intégrer une culture de responsabilité et d'amélioration continue. De la conduite des audits à l'encadrement des dirigeants et des enquêtes sur les non-conformités, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour assurer que notre système de gestion intégré (SGI) demeure efficace et conforme aux exigences de certification. Ce que vous allez faire
• Diriger les programmes de vérification interne et appuyer les vérifications externes de certification
• Lancer des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui améliorent les performances opérationnelles
• Enquêter sur les non-conformités, analyser les causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et la gouvernance en cours du SGI
• Partenariat avec les superviseurs et les dirigeants pour renforcer la culture de la qualité
• Élaborer et coordonner des plans de conformité de qualité et des initiatives de formation
• Veiller à ce que la documentation et les processus soient conformes aux normes ISO
• Fournir des conseils pratiques et utiles aux équipes opérationnelles À propos de toi Vous êtes pragmatiques, orientés vers les détails et confiants qui influencent les intervenants à tous les niveaux. Vous n'identifiez pas les problèmes, vous les résolvez. Vous apportez :
• Expérience dans les environnements de fabrication, mécanique ou électrique
• Forte connaissance pratique des systèmes de qualité et des normes de certification
• La confiance pour engager les dirigeants et remettre en question le statu quo
• Excellentes compétences en gestion du temps et en communication
• Un état d'esprit proactif avec une passion pour l'amélioration continue Qualifications et expérience
• Qualification d'auditeur principal (ISO 9001)
• La qualification professionnelle ou technique est fortement privilégiée (l'électricité est avantageuse)
• Expérience de mise en œuvre de systèmes de qualité ou d'amélioration continue
• Très souhaitable : expérience en certification Ex (IECEx 60079.19 et AS/NZS 3800) et bonne compréhension des moteurs électriques AC/DC. Ce que nous vous offrons Un système de bonus basé sur la performance qui récompense vraiment l'impact et les résultats Téléphone fourni par l'entreprise, ordinateur portable et carte de crédit d'entreprise Programme d'aide aux employés pour soutenir votre bien-être Un environnement hautement collaboratif avec une forte influence opérationnelle Une organisation mondiale offrant des possibilités de développement de carrière à long terme Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Tecnico de Taller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
Required Education

• Intermediate or Advanced Electromechanical Technician (equivalent to FP I / FP II) or equivalent hands-on experience.

Specific Knowledge

• Basic Occupational Risk Prevention Training (Nivel Básico) and safety training related to the risks of the specific work area..

• Valid driver’s license.

Purpose of the Role
Ensure the delivery of high‑quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment both in the workshop and at customer sites. Provide technical troubleshooting and support in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the Service Center team.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Work

• Execute planned tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high‑quality mechanical and electrical service to company customers (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation).

• Provide technical solutions to day‑to‑day issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager.

• Supervise installations, assemblies, and commissioning activities performed by Sulzer subcontractors in the area, following the instructions of the Workshop Manager.

• Act as a point of contact for the Sales team in the assigned region, assisting with technical site visits when required for measurements, analysis, studies, or when the complexity of a quotation or project justifies technical involvement.

• Perform driving and delivery tasks for the Mining & Construction division (delivery of pumps to customers) whenever required by the Workshop Manager based on the workload and work organization.

What we offer you

• Ability to handle tools, coordinate actions, and perform manual tasks.
• Attention to detail and precision.
• Ability to work logically and systematically to achieve consistent performance in a highly structured environment.
• A consistent individual with the ability to tie up loose ends and supervise tasks until successful completion.
• A self-disciplined, patient, and careful individual.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Pasadena, Texas

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Assist in inspecting and maintaining machinery and mechanical systems.
Perform basic repairs and part replacements.
Support preventive maintenance routines.
Clean and organize tools and work areas.
Follow safety procedures and report hazards.
Document maintenance activities.
Learn and apply mechanical troubleshooting techniques.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Basic mechanical aptitude.
Willingness to learn and follow instructions.
Good teamwork and communication skills.
Attention to detail and safety awareness.
Ability to use basic hand tools.

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance

Wellness program

jobs.title: Steam Turbine Technical Field Authority

titleByLocale.fr: Autorité de terrain technique de turbine à vapeur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To support our growth plans, we’re looking for a Steam Turbine Technical Field Authority who will play a critical, high‑impact role in developing, delivering, and shaping our steam turbine offering across Sulzer’s UK Service Network. If you want to grow your career, take on complex turbine challenges, and be backed by real investment and real capability, this is where you’ll thrive.

At Sulzer, you’ll be part of a team with one of the UK’s most advanced high‑speed balancing capabilities, handling rotors up to 50 tonnes, supported by 14 specialist Service Centres equipped with cutting‑edge rotating equipment expertise.
About the Role

This is not just another field role. This is a key technical authority position at the centre of Sulzer’s expanding Steam Turbine capability, working directly with customers, influencing project scope, and supporting major steam turbine overhauls, upgrades, repairs, and field service mobilisation.
You’ll be the technical expert our teams rely on. The person customers trust. And the driving force behind the success of UK-wide steam turbine projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Scope and evaluate work at customer sites across the UK, acting as the technical lead for inspections, diagnosis, and repair recommendations.

• Provide expert technical guidance to Sulzer Service Centres nationwide, ensuring alignment on engineering standards and steam turbine best practice.

• Support delivery of complex projects, from major overhauls to precision balancing, rotor assessments, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and outage support.

• Interface directly with customers, advising on condition, risk, repair options and project planning.

• Drive continuous improvement, working with engineering, operations, and field service teams to enhance our turbine offering and market competitiveness.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in Steam Turbine engineering, ideally within field service, overhauls, or rotating equipment environments.

• Proven experience in site-based inspections, fault-finding, and technical assessment.

• Confidence working directly with customers to scope, advise, and lead on technical solutions.

• The ability to act as a “go‑to” authority for steam turbine matters across multiple teams.

• A passion for engineering excellence, problem‑solving, and continuous improvement.

• Willingness to travel UK-wide as required.

What we offer you

• This is a fully remote, home‑based role that gives you full autonomy over your diary and time, with travel across the UK as required.

A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• The option of a car/allowance (EV options are available)

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Wexford site is a centre of excellence for wastewater pump technology, where engineering teams work hands‑on with products that end up protecting communities, infrastructure and the environment worldwide. From early development through to full certification, Wexford plays a pivotal role in turning innovative designs into proven, reliable solutions used by customers across global markets. If you enjoy seeing the real‑world impact of your work, this is a site where engineering truly matters.

As a Test Engineer, you’ll be right at the heart of that journey. Your work directly supports Product Development, Product Introduction and Continuous Technology projects, helping transform design concepts into robust, compliant products used in real‑world wastewater applications. You’ll build deep technical expertise across hydraulic, mechanical, electrical and compliance testing, working closely with local and global development teams. This is a role with real ownership, visible influence on product decisions, and the opportunity to grow your capability as Sulzer continues to invest in advanced testing and future technologies.
What you’ll be doing

• Perform hydraulic performance testing including flow, head, efficiency and NPSH

• Execute mechanical and electrical testing such as vibration, noise and motor performance

• Carry out electrical safety testing (dielectric, insulation resistance, leakage current)

• Test pumps under simulated wastewater conditions, including solids handling, clogging behaviour, wear and lifetime performance

• Project manage global testing requirements for products, aligning test strategies, resources and timelines with international teams

• Conduct performance, safety and compliance testing in line with ISO, EN, IEC, Hydraulic Institute (HI), CSA / UL, IECEEC and FM standards

• Produce regulatory‑compliant test plans, protocols and reports for certification submissions

• Support third‑party audits and inspections, including CSA (SMTC) assessments

• Analyse and interpret test data to identify trends, deviations or non‑conformities

• Investigate test failures, recommend corrective actions and support design improvements

What you bring

• A strong technical foundation in hydraulics, mechanical or electrical engineering

• Experience with test execution, validation or compliance testing in an engineering or manufacturing environment

• A structured, detail‑oriented approach combined with the confidence to work cross‑functionally

• The ability to balance hands‑on testing with documentation, analysis and stakeholder collaboration

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuous professional development

• Genuine opportunities for international mobility and long‑term progression

• Work on globally deployed wastewater technology that delivers real environmental impact

• Access to advanced test facilities and complex, varied engineering challenges

• Be part of a collaborative site with strong links to global engineering and R&D teams

• Build deep technical expertise while shaping future‑ready testing standards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Machinist

Company:** Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc.

Job Summary

Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc. is seeking a skilled Machinist to operate and maintain various machine tools, producing precision components and parts for our industrial pump systems. This role is crucial for ensuring the quality and timely delivery of our products.

Job Responsibilities

* Set up, operate, and maintain a variety of machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, grinders, and drill presses to fabricate or repair metallic and non-metallic parts.
* Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and engineering specifications to determine machining operations, sequences, and dimensions.
* Select appropriate tools, cutting speeds, and feed rates based on material type and part specifications.
* Inspect finished products for conformance to specifications using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
* Perform routine maintenance on machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues with machinery or parts, making necessary adjustments or repairs.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area, adhering to all safety regulations and company policies.
* Collaborate with engineers and other team members to optimize machining processes and improve product quality.
* Document work performed, including measurements, materials used, and any issues encountered.

Job Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent; completion of a vocational program or apprenticeship in machining is highly preferred.
* Proven experience as a Machinist, with a strong understanding of various machine tools and machining principles.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, and schematics.
* Strong knowledge of various materials (e.g., steel, aluminum, brass, plastics) and their machining properties.
* Expertise in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, calipers, depth gauges, etc.) and maintaining tight tolerances.
* Ability to perform mathematical calculations relevant to machining operations.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and procedures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Physical ability to lift and move heavy objects, stand for extended periods, and perform repetitive tasks.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required
• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
• Designs setups and methods where none exist
• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques
• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:
• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training
• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
• Ability to setup machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill
• Four years of experience in machine shop operations
• Willingness to work in a team environment
• Openness to working overtime as required

QUALIFICATIONS:
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training
• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill
• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision
• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application
• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds
• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment
• Willingness to work in a team environment
• Ability to work overtime as required

jobs.title: CAD CAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sr. Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This role ensures that engineering solutions meet operational, safety, and environmental standards while supporting continuous improvement in plant infrastructure and equipment.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Purpose of the job
Assist CAD Supervisor & Workshop Engineer in providing data related to Reverse Engineering and repair process.

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Perform visual, material & dimensional inspection at workshop or on site for turbomachinery parts as per instruction if needed.

• Provide visual, material & dimensional inspection report if needed.

• Perform 3D scanning process using portable scanner such as Handy scan or CMM portable if needed.

• Coordination with other production department related to machining process for CNC machine, Reverse Engineering process and repair process.

• Review Inspection report related with Reverse Engineering process & repair process.

• Provide 3D model & manufacturing drawing prior to approval.

• Provide CAM program and Machining Jig drawing.

• Maintain measuring tools & CMM portable to ensure they remain fit to use.

• Contribute to the company's LEAN & safety program.

Skills & Qualifications

• Diploma Degree (D-3) in Mechanical Engineering

• Minimum 5 years’ working experience

• Understand about Engineering Technical Drawing Standard

• Understand about Mechanical Engineering Design

• Understand about machining process

• Understand about G-Code

• Understand about CNC machine (4 axis & 5 axis)

• Good communication and cooperation skills

• Fluent in English (verbal and written)

• Able to use measurement tools properly

• Able to use computer technology

• Proficient in MS Office & PDF Tools

• Proficient in CAD Software (Prefer AutoCAD Mechanical & Autodesk Inventor)

• Proficient in CAM Software such as MasterCAM X5 & Siemens NX 1973

What we offer you

• Career Opportunities

• Medical Insurance

• Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: EM Field Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for the overhaul, repair, installation & commissioning of Electro Mechanical equipment to support our client. Preparing, coordinating and carrying out inspections and repairs of all Motor types and Generator at customer sites inside and outside the country, within the specified time and at the estimated cost. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Carrying out reparations and inspections inside and outside the country at customer sites.

• Provision of safe and effective site and workshop overhaul, repair, installation and commissioning services for Electro Mechanical family rotating equipment.

• Be the first point of contact for allocated customers in respect of any issues relating to agreed on-site scopes of work.

• Develop strong relationships with key client contacts.

• Be responsible for on-site Health & Safety.

• Compile on-site Risk Assessments for scopes of work.

• Lead and supervise on-site repair teams during site contract execution.

• Provide continuous improvement in repair, installation and commissioning activities.

• Develop and maintain good and effective relationships with clients to optimise further service opportunities.

• Liaise with technical departments within Sulzer to develop engineering solutions.

• Manage relevant suppliers and subcontractors.

• Compilation of comprehensive site reports in line with company quality management system.

• Communication: communicates (in English as well) with Supervisor Field Service, Site Manager, contractors, and internal Sulzer Services departments.

• Writing daily reports.

• Work with: PC, MS Office package, telephone, hand tools, lifting equipment and gear, Sulzer regulations, OEM instructions, customer rules and regulations and local safety regulations.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical or Electrical.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Electric Motor and Turbo Generator maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with Electrical Inspection such as insulation Resistance, Polarization Index, Widing Resistance etc and Mechanical Inspection such as Stator Wedge Analysis, Bump Test, Etc

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Relevant experience of minimum 5 years of working on Electric Motor and Turbo Generator.

• Proficient in English. Certification in TOEIC is Preferable

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

• Past worked in the OEM is preferable

• Familiar with safety code and procedure for startup and commissioning

What we offer you

Career opportunities
Medical Benefit
Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To receive hand over Project from Sales/Tendering and manage it until delivery to customers and completion of warranty period. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Leads Project Managers Team and provide direction / support for escalated project issues.

• Provide Sales and Cash Colletion update to Top Management in regular basis.

• Work closely with Sales team to gather insights of upcoming projects and provide feedback if needed.

• Bridge communication with respective parties including Customer for any disputes and settle it.

• Review all project progress in regular basis and point out any risk observed and settle with respective PM.

• Review project life cycle by planning, budgeting, scheduling and tracking a project plan and execution to meet customer expectations and comply with commercial agreements.

• Challenge Sales forecasting for existing project backlog to get more revenues

• Define project goals, communicate with stakeholders, team members, vendors, and customers, and manage a project through to its closure.

• Order booking, managing project resources (including teams and workers) and documenting the progress of the project.

• Assessing and mitigating the risk, troubleshooting, and leading quality assurance to delight customers and deliver project margin as committed or even better.

• Responsible for billing/invoicing, revenue, and cash collection, updated regularly, and took necessary action to meet the target.

• Conduct people and performance review: people development, competency review, succession planning, cross-culture, code of conduct, and compliance.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated mindset

• Sense of commercial (financial acumen)

• Multi-tasking

Education requirements:

• Bachelor degree in engineering or in related field

Job experience:

• > 5 years work related experience mainly in the engineered-to-order and services.

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language):

• Fluent English

• Project management

• Computer literate and Microsoft office

What we offer you

Job Opportunity
Medical Benefit
Saving Plan

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: TS Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for pre-commissioning, commissioning, troubleshooting, start-up, and testing of rotating equipment and related mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems; supervising DIRA activities; monitoring field operations and reporting findings; acting as company representative in customer communications; ensuring compliance with ISO, HSE, and company regulations; promoting workplace safety through inspections and Stop Work Authority; and coordinating with Project, Sales, Engineering, and Workshop teams to ensure successful project execution.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.

• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.

• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.

• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system

• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.

• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.

• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request

• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative

• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.

• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.

• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.

• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.

• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated minset

• Multi-tasking

• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment

• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage

• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
