jobs.title: Early Careers Coordinator (Maternity Cover – 14 Months)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about developing early talent and supporting people at the start of their careers? We’re looking for a highly organised, people‑focused Early Careers Coordinator to join our team on a maternity cover basis, based in Leeds.
• Start date: June (to allow for handover)

• Contract: Fixed-term, 14 months

• Reporting to: Learning & Development Manager

This role plays a key part in delivering a positive experience for our graduates and apprentices across Sulzer’s UK operations. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys responsibility, autonomy and being the central point of coordination for early careers programmes.

What you’ll be doing

• Coordinating and supporting Sulzer’s early careers programmes, including graduates and apprentices

• Acting as a key point of contact for early careers participants, providing guidance and support throughout their journey

• Managing programme activities such as inductions, rotations, development milestones and key events

• Maintaining accurate early careers records and tracking progression and outcomes

• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business to ensure a smooth and consistent early careers experience

• Working closely with the Learning & Development Manager and the Leeds‑based L&D team to ensure programmes run effectively

About you

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail

• Confident managing your own workload, diary and priorities

• A clear, professional communicator who enjoys working with people

• Comfortable using HR or learning systems (experience with learning platforms is a plus)

Location, travel & flexibility

• Leeds will be your primary working location, with hybrid working available (office and home)

• Some UK travel required, primarily to Birmingham, with occasional travel to Aberdeen and other UK locations

• Planned travel only, with occasional overnight stays – no last‑minute “drop‑everything” requests

• Full UK driving licence required

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary.

• Flexitime policy supporting a balanced and flexible approach to working hours.

• 33 days annual leave .

• Defined pension contribution.

• Medicash healthcare plan, helping cover everyday costs such as dental, optical and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing benefits.

• Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential support when you need it.

• Wide range of discounts on shopping, entertainment and lifestyle, with access to apply for Costco membership.

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Modern working environment – Our Leeds site is undergoing a significant renovation, creating a refreshed, high‑quality and modern workspace.

• Onsite facilities – Enjoy a 24/7 gym, subsidised canteen, vending machines, and an active Sports & Social Club.

• Support for veterans, reservists and cadet adult volunteers – Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme and actively welcomes ex‑military personnel.

Why join us?

• A meaningful role shaping the experience of future talent

• High levels of autonomy and trust in how you manage your time

• Supportive, collaborative L&D team with a structured handover

• Opportunity to gain broad exposure across learning and development activities

About Sulzer

Sulzer is a global engineering company specialising in fluid engineering and chemical processing solutions for industries that are essential to everyday life, including energy, water and manufacturing.

Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ around 13,500 people worldwide across 160 locations, generating CHF 3.5 billion in annual turnover. Our technologies help customers improve energy efficiency, reduce emissions and support the transition to

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
SUMMARY:
Performs sandblast and paint application tasks in accordance with SPSI standard procedure processes as well as specific customer requirements.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME

 Operates sandblast equipment to provide required surface preparation 35%

 Performs mixing of various types of paint materials. 5%
 Operates conventional spray equipment, including brush to provide a high quality industrial finish to parts and components 35%
 Moves parts and components as needed with forklift or overhead pendant crane 5%
 Dispose of paint waste materials as required by company, state and federal regulations 5%

 Adheres to Safety and Take 5 culture 5%
 Supports and cooperates with Four Principles 5%
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Other duties as assigned 5%

TOTAL PERCENT OF TIME: 100%
QUALIFICATIONS:
 High School graduate or equivalent
 Minimum of 1 year experience operating sandblast equipment
 Minimum of 2 years of experience operating conventional spray equipment
 Forklift and pendant crane experience is helpful
 Minimum 1 year of experience mixing and applying epoxies, polyurethane, inorganic zinc and alkyd enamel paints.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Técnico
Senior Project Manager (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of complex, long‑term customer contracts (e.g., LTSA / framework agreements) and high‑risk projects. You’ll be the key link between our customers and internal teams—bringing people together, keeping delivery on track, and building strong, long‑term partnerships. In this role, you’ll lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix environment, communicate confidently with senior customer stakeholders, and spot opportunities to grow the business. Main accountabilities and tasks

• Ensure contractual execution within cost, time, quality and Sulzer PM standards

• Manage financial performance of customer contracts, including cost control, forecasting and invoicing aligned with as‑sold budgets and milestones

• Act as primary customer interface: contract updates, issue resolution, claims, variations and addenda negotiations

• Present contract progress to senior management on a regular basis

• Create and maintain customer, contract and project data, proposals, TOA calculations, purchase orders and scope releases in the Business Management System

• Coordinate project handovers and communication between customers, execution centers and operations

• Lead and manage project teams within a matrix organization

• Ensure full contractual compliance, handle NCRs and customer complaints

• Develop business insights, business cases and support continuous improvement initiatives

• Support customer visits, ensure safety inductions, PPE compliance and ESH requirements

• Promote quality improvements, safety awareness and identify risks and improvement opportunities, escalating with recommended solutions

What we're looking for:

• 9+ years of experience in project and contract management, preferably in complex and international environments

• Experience with industrial rotating equipment

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred; project management background is a plus

• Recognized project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMI, PM²) or equivalent degree

• Strong experience in contract and commercial management, including legal aspects

• Confident communication and negotiation skills at senior customer management level

• Proven ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix organization

• Strong communication skills; proactive, well‑organized and solution‑driven people manager

• Fluent English required

• Willingness to travel 25–50% worldwide

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Técnico
Project Manager/Business Admin Apprentice
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Start your career at Sulzer’s Falkirk Service Centre, the specialist hub for high‑voltage testing, repair and refurbishment of large industrial equipment. This is where complex, heavy‑duty engineering comes to life - and as an apprentice, you’ll work alongside expert engineers and project managers, learning hands‑on skills and knowledge that help power major industries across the UK and beyond.

Our Project Manager Apprenticeship gives you real life experience, exposure to a variety of business projects and the chance to build solid technical skills in a professional engineering environment. Key Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day administrative support to teams or managers

• Assist with creating and updating project plans, schedules, and timelines

• Communicate project updates to stakeholders and team members

• Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems

• Input and update information using internal systems and spreadsheets

• Act as a first point of contact for internal and external enquiries

• Communicate professionally via email, phone, and face-to-face

• Support customer or stakeholder queries and escalate where required

• Assist with improving administrative processes and ways of working

• Support business operations such as procurement, invoicing, or project management

• Help monitor KPIs and produce basic performance reports

What We’re Looking For
We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about engineering and ready to learn. You’ll be a great fit if you have:

• 3 National 5’s (passes) , including Maths and English

• Motivation to learn and develop new skills

• Good time ‑ management and organisational ability

• A positive, flexible attitude and strong attention to detail

• Prior business administration or project management experience isn’t required - just curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to get involved.

What we offer you

• Competitive apprentice pay that increases as you progress

• Mentoring and support from experienced professionals

• Opportunities to work with modern technology and innovative applications

• Sponsored education with pathways to higher qualifications

• Potential short placements at other UK sites

• Opportunities to work with teams or customers internationally

• Strong potential for a permanent role on successful completion

• Long ‑ term development and progression routes within Sulzer

• A UK-wide apprentice community of more than 80 peers

• 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays)

• Company pension scheme

What Will Your Time as an Apprentice Look Like?

Year 1 – Full‑Time College
You’ll spend your first year at college working towards a Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification. This gives you the foundation knowledge and core skills you’ll need before joining the team on-site.

Years 2, 3 & 4 – On‑Site Development
From your second year onwards, you’ll be based within our engineering teams. You’ll gain hands‑on experience, apply what you’ve learned, and continue your studies towards a Level 3 qualification and your final Apprenticeship Standard. Throughout this time you’ll receive regular mentoring, internal training, and opportunities to broaden your experience across different engineering tasks.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: HR Advisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Recruitment-focused HR role managing hiring, onboarding, data and leader support while building strong relationships across the business. Looking to take ownership of recruitment while still building your broader HR skillset? This is your opportunity to step into a hands-on, high-impact role supporting a global business in a growing and essential industry.

We’re on the lookout for a driven HR Advisor to lead end-to-end recruitment whilst also supporting key HR processes that keep our business running smoothly.

What you’ll be doing

This is a recruitment-heavy role with real ownership and variety. You’ll partner closely with leaders across the business to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

Key focus areas include:

• Leading end-to-end recruitment across a range of roles (with a strong focus on skilled trades)

• Managing onboarding and candidate experience from offer to day one throughout probation

• Supporting immigration and visa processes for temporary and permanent employees

• Maintaining accurate employee data and workflows in Workday

• Supporting leaders with performance processes (probation, annual reviews)

• Providing generalist HR support across employee lifecycle activities

• Contributing to HR reporting and projects as needed

You’ll also stay connected with our Service Centres across Australia, building strong relationships and ensuring HR is visible, practical and value-adding.

What we’re looking for

You’re someone who enjoys being in the detail but also thrives on building relationships and influencing outcomes.

• 2–3 years’ experience in HR and/or recruitment

• Strong experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes

• Confident communicator with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels

• Highly organised with strong time management skills

• Comfortable working across systems (experience with Workday highly regarded)

• A proactive, solutions-focused mindset

What we offer you

• Performance-based bonus that genuinely rewards impact

• Company phone & laptop

• Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing

• Global organisation with strong career development opportunities

• 12 month contract role with an intension to move to perm

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technicien d'usinage
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Mechanical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems, including perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to analyze the structural integrity of the designed components.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision Purpose of the job

Execute engineering Task and act as Subject Expert Matter on mechanical engineering analysis and stress analysis with FEA software.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Analyze and calculate mechanical task issues such as stress analysis, etc.
Understand all advance mechanical engineering structural analysis, including stress concentration factors, ratio of stress to yield, etc.
Conduct advance analysis using Finite element Software, mainly with ANSYS Mechanical and its derivatives
Understand fundamental geometry modification
Understand advance meshing
Have full understanding of bounndary condition (constraints and force) application
Have understanding about fluid dynamic and CFD
Lead and conduct as required meetings with shop personnel, customers and others.
Perform communication / contact with customers on the technical issues or work progress.
Able to explain highly complex structural analysis in easily understandable terms

• Provide solutions for problems while performing the project with regards to quality, time, and cost.

• Prepare engineering report, including progress report.

Field Assignment

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Location: Pasadena, TX (1910 Jasmine Drive)
On‑site role with up to 40% field service

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer supports the inspection, repair, and documentation of rotating equipment by combining hands‑on shop and field work with engineering documentation and customer communication. This role works closely with the machine shop, quotation team, and customers to help define accurate repair scopes and ensure quality execution.

This position is intended for engineers with practical mechanical experience who can work independently with general guidance. Training will be provided as part of onboarding. This role is primarily based on‑site in Pasadena, TX, with occasional field service assignments (up to 40%). The engineer will split time between hands‑on mechanical work, inspections, measurements, and engineering documentation. The role requires close coordination with the repair shop, internal teams, and customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Support rotating equipment inspections and repair evaluations to help define accurate work scopes

• Act as a mechanical point of contact for customers during inspections and repairs

• Coordinate with the machine shop and quotation team on mechanical findings and requirements

• Create and update CAD drawings to document design or repair changes for customer review

• Perform or verify precision measurements using micrometers and calipers

• Participate in day‑to‑day shop and field operations, including repair support

• Assist with field service overhauls as required

• Document findings clearly and complete assigned tasks on schedule

Preferred (3+ years total across one or more of the following):

• Rotating equipment repair or overhaul

• Rotating equipment manufacturing

• Rotating equipment package design and assembly

• Field service for mechanical equipment

• Vibration analysis or diagnostics

Technical Skills & Knowledge

• Proficient with CAD software (SolidWorks or AutoDesk)

• Working knowledge of:

• Rolling element bearings

• Sleeve/babbitt bearings

• Mechanical seals and oil seals

• Shaft alignment

• Vibration spectrums and interpretation

• Comfortable using micrometers and calipers

• Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred

• If not already experienced, this skill will be taught on the job

Required Attributes

• Self‑motivated and willing to learn through on‑the‑job training

• Comfortable working in a hands‑on, industrial environment

• Able to take ownership of assigned work and complete tasks in a timely manner

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

What we offer you

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with 6% company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Gym membership and wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior ICT Supporter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Provide 2nd‑level IT support, both on‑site and remotely, for all users of Sulzer Ltd, primarily within the assigned region and, if required, across other regions

• Monitor and maintain the entire local IT infrastructure, including desktop and mobile Windows devices, MFPs, company‑specific hardware and software, user and access management, servers, network components, etc.

• Install and configure end‑user devices, including mobile phones

• Handle hardware procurement and inventory management

• Receive, analyze, and resolve incidents and service requests within 2nd‑level support using standard IT tools

• Escalate incidents and service requests to 3rd‑level support, external local service providers, or management when required

• Perform tasks in accordance with ITIL standards, primarily using the company’s internal ticketing system ServiceNow (SNOW), while adhering to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Technically coordinate and set up video conferences (Microsoft Teams / Yealink)

• Manage and maintain internal meeting room infrastructure

• Collaborate on and support local and global IT projects

• Train and coach new employees and trainees

Special Key Responsibilities

• Provide specialized IT support and daily assistance to VIP users, including support during external executive meetings and town halls

• Member of a cross‑functional team (DevOps: Local IT – Datacenter)

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Successfully completed IT education or training

• Several years of professional experience in 2nd‑ and/or 3rd‑level IT support

• Experience in VIP support is an advantage (preferably in a comparable corporate environment)

• Broad knowledge in network (Cisco), DDC (Hyper-V), AD, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, Intune etc.

• ITIL and/or Microsoft certifications (Server / Client / Network) are an advantage

• Very good English skills and good German skills would be a strong advantage.

• Strong customer‑ and service‑oriented mindset

• Analytical, structured, and solution‑oriented approach

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team‑oriented environment

• Flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, and willingness to undertake occasional business travel

• Availability to work in shift hours (7am - 4pm / 9am - 6pm)

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Winder Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving.

A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference.

We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities

• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes

• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures

• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding

• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers

• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time

Job Qualifications

• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)

• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors

• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings

• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Annual companywide bonus

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus

jobs.title: MRP Controller and Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for end‑to‑end production and material planning through effective MRP execution, inventory control, and cross‑functional coordination to ensure smooth order flow from planning to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Achieve ≥92% On‑Time Delivery and 100% Sales Order Compliance.

• Execute MRP planning, ensuring accurate and timely release of BOMs and requisitions.

• Plan, schedule, and close planned and production orders aligned with forecasts and customer dates.

• Manage routings and production order closures to meet operational targets.

• Monitor end‑to‑end order timelines (PR, PO, production, and delivery) and resolve delays.

• Coordinate with Purchasing, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, and Logistics for seamless execution.

• Optimize inventory and material flow to support production, backlog clearance, and OTD performance.

• Drive digital planning improvements and COGS reduction initiatives through process optimization.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor Mechanical Engineering

• 5-8 Years of Experience in MRP and Planning (End to end execution)

• SAP PP and MM, MS Excel, RFC and compliance

• Production Planning & Control

• Inventory Management & Optimization

• Strong Communication Skills

• Attention to Detail

• Time & Priority Management

• Collaboration & Teamwork

What we offer you

• A great working environment.

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: MRO Gas Turbine Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced MRO Gas Turbine Engineer to provide technical expertise and support for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of gas turbine components and systems. This role is crucial in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of critical equipment for our clients. Job Responsibilities

• Setting technical specifications for the overhaul, inspection, and repair of aero-derivative gas turbines

• Overseeing disassembly, inspection and reassembly activities, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, tolerances and standards

• Leading troubleshooting and diagnostic investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives, applying Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, OEMs, supply chain, and operations to deliver seamless project execution

Job Qualifications

• Strong technical expertise in gas turbines and rotating equipment, with practical experience of MRO environments

• Proven track record in repair schemes, diagnostics, and troubleshooting

• Knowledge of RB211 and/or Avon products (desirable but not essential)

• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions

• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)

• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Annual Bonus scheme based on personal and company performance

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Private Medical Insurance (Self)

• Access free on-site parking and employee discounts across shopping, lifestyle, and entertainment

• Use our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support services and wellbeing resources

• Develop your skills through continuous learning and Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Be part of a supportive, innovative team with genuine opportunities for career progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Warranty Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests.

Key Responsibilities

Warranty Claims & Process Management

• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.

• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.

• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).

• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle.

Customer & Stakeholder Interface

• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.

• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.

• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.

• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries.

Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline

• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.

• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.

• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.

• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure.

Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution

• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.

• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.

• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations.

Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management

• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.

• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.

• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.

• Translate customer feedback into improvement actions in coordination with Engineering, Quality, and Service teams.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

• Ensure warranty activities align with departmental KPIs, including Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline.

• Monitor performance indicators such as claim cycle time, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and recurrence trends.

• Identify systemic issues and contribute to process, design, or quality improvements to reduce future warranty exposure.

• Capture and communicate lessons learned to relevant stakeholders and governance forums.

Leadership & Capability Development

• Provide technical and process guidance to junior professionals involved in warranty claim execution.

• Review work outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standar

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the job

The role is responsible for driving sustainable Order Intake growth for Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components (MTC) business through:

• Active hunting of brownfield revamp opportunities from existing operating assets

• Early involvement and development of greenfield / grassroot CAPEX projects, from feasibility to FID

• Providing front‑end technical sales leadership, translating customer process challenges into differentiated, value‑based MTC solutions

Main tasks and responsibilities
Revamp & Brownfield

• Proactively identify revamp, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, separation efficiency improvement, and reliability upgrade opportunities in existing operating plants

• Ability to conduct asset‑level analysis (age of internals, operating issues, performance gaps, fouling, corrosion, capacity creep, energy efficiency requirements)

• Drive revamp‑led sales strategies, including Tray replacement, Packing retrofits (random ↔ structured), Mist eliminator and separator upgrades, Hydraulic rating changes and column internals optimization

• Position Sulzer as a lifecycle partner, not just an equipment supplier

Greenfield/Grassroot Project Development

• Actvely pursue new CAPEX grassroot projects

• Engage customers, licensors, consultants & EPCs early (feasibility,pre-FEED,FEED)

• Coordinate with application & technology, global applications teams in accordance to Sulzer project governance to lock in Sulzer MTC solutions early.

Technical & Application Leadership

• Translate customer challenges into value-based technical proposals that differentiate MTC from competitors with Application & Technology team.

• Order Intake & Sales Achievement
Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• Strategic Planning & Execution
Implement long‑term and short‑term business strategies and ensure alignment with regional and global MTCS initiatives.

• Proposal Follow-up & CRM Management
Proactively follow up on outstanding proposals and maintain accurate, up-to-date information in the Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely with Head Office, Regional Offices, and local intermediaries to support project acquisition, proposal development, and market initiatives.

• Market Intelligence & Reporting
Provide regular updates on market trends, competitive landscape, project pipeline, and sales forecasts to support strategic decision-making.

jobs.title: Consultor(a) de RH
HR Administration & Payroll Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

Sulzer is an equal opportunity em

• Tenere aggiornato con i cambiamenti normativi e tradurli in processi operativi. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno
• Laurea in Risorse Umane, Business Administration, o in un campo relativo.
• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione delle risorse umane e nel libro paga svizzero (obbligatorio).
• Forte comprensione del diritto del lavoro svizzero, del sistema di sicurezza sociale, delle imposte e della conformità all'occupazione.
• L'esperienza in ambienti multinazionali è un bene.
• Forte competenza MS Office e HRIS; competenze del sistema payroll richiesto.

Sur le rôle Le gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie est chargé de diriger et de superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH et les opérations de paye de bout en bout pour la Suisse. Ce rôle assure le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des règlements de sécurité sociale, des obligations fiscales et des politiques internes. Le poste est le principal point de contact pour les opérations des RH, l'administration du cycle de vie des employés, l'exactitude de la paye et l'intégrité du système des RH. Le rôle doit être exécuté de façon pratique, en assurant des processus de RH efficaces et une prestation de services de haute qualité aux employés et aux gestionnaires. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités Gestion de la paie (Swiss Payroll)
• Surveiller et exécuter la paie mensuelle de tous les employés suisses, y compris la rémunération variable, les indemnités, les déductions et les absences.
• Gérer les contrôles des états de paie, les rapprochements, les audits et les activités d'établissement de rapports.
• Assurer un calcul correct des impôts, des cotisations de sécurité sociale, des retenues sur fonds de pension et des primes d'assurance.
• Agir en tant que contact clé pour les employés sur les questions de paie, de prestations et de gestion du temps.
• Collaborer avec le ministère des Finances à la comptabilité des états de paie, à la fourniture des salaires et à la vérification des comptes.
• Gérer les activités de fin d'année (certificats de salaire, clôture de l'année fiscale de retenue, déclaration de sécurité sociale) Administration des RH et gestion du cycle de vie des employés
• Agir en tant que conseiller en ressources humaines de confiance auprès des cadres et des dirigeants basés en Suisse
• Gérer et superviser tous les processus administratifs de RH pour l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés (embauche à la retraite).
• Préparer des contrats de travail, des amendements, des lettres de référence et d'autres documents juridiques conformément au droit suisse.
• Assurer la maintenance exacte des dossiers des employés et des fichiers numériques du personnel.
• Gérer les processus d'embarquement et de hors-bord, y compris les permis de travail (L, B, C) et la liaison avec les autorités.
• Veiller à ce que les institutions de sécurité sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), les fonds de pension (BVG/LPP), l'assurance contre les accidents (UVG), le KTG et les bureaux d'allocations familiales soient enregistrés et informés en temps voulu.
• Soutenir les cycles annuels de performance et de rémunération du point de vue administratif.
• Assurer le respect des politiques internes, du RGPD et des réglementations suisses en matière de protection des données. Systèmes RH et optimisation des processus
• Maintenir et optimiser les systèmes HRIS et de suivi du temps (par exemple SAP, Workday, Abacus ou similaire).
• Assurer l'exactitude et la fiabilité des données pour les rapports et les analyses.
• Favoriser l'amélioration des processus et la normalisation de l'administration des RH et des états de paie.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de nouveaux outils et de solutions numériques RH.
• Conformité, politiques et gouvernance.
• Assurer le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des conventions collectives (le cas échéant) et des politiques de l'entreprise.
• Maintenir les cadres de gouvernance des RH et appuyer les audits des RH.
• Se tenir au courant des changements réglementaires et les traduire en processus opérationnels. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin
• Diplôme en ressources humaines, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe.
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans l'administration des RH et la paie suisse (obligatoire).
• Une bonne compréhension du droit du travail, du système de sécurité sociale, des impôts et de l'emploi.
• L'expérience dans les environnements multinationaux est un atout.
• Compétences solides du MS Office et du HRIS; compétences requises du système de paye.
• En allemand et en anglais.
• Temps de travail: 80 - 100 %. Aucun visa ou permis de travail ne peut être fourni pour ce rôle. Avez-vous une question sur le rôle? Contactez Alexi Donadoni à l'adresse alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 25 jours de congé (excluant les jours fériés) + jours de service
• Régime de pension à cotisations déterminées
• Programme d'aide aux employés/soins de santé
• Parking sur place/indemnité de transport public
• Accès à une large gamme de réductions Sulzer est une égalité des chances

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
Field Machining Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Field Machining Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Key Responsibilities

• Supervise production or service staff and assign daily tasks.

• Monitor workflow and ensure production targets are met.

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.

• Maintain equipment and report maintenance needs.

• Train new employees and support skill development.

• Identify process improvements and implement changes.

• Communicate production status to management.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically requires a technical degree and several years of relevant work experience to be able to manage and coordinate one or more professional-level teams.

• Experience in manufacturing or production supervision.

• Strong leadership and organizational skills.

• Knowledge of safety and quality standards.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues.

• Effective communication and team coordination skills.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

• Desenvolver, implementar e controlar programas e sistemas de gestão, garantia e controle da qualidade;

• Conduzir análises, pesquisas e melhorias contínuas em métodos, processos, formulações e padrões de qualidade;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a modificação de metodologias relacionadas à confiabilidade, ensaios e processos produtivos;

• Realizar acompanhamento técnico e suporte especializado às áreas envolvidas em auditorias, inspeções e projetos internos.

Habilidades Necessárias

• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica/Produção e áreas afins;

• Conhecimento das normas de execução e critérios de aceitação de Ensaios Não Destrutivos (END);

• Conhecimento em Metrologia e interpretação de desenho mecânico;

• Conhecimento em Gestão da Qualidade;

• Inglês intermediário.

What we offer you

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida.
Vale alimentação e refeição no local.
Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass.
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
Previdência privada.
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role involves providing engineering troubleshooting & solutions. Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts. Manage internal and external subcontracted work. Develop repair specifications, drawings, forms, and processes. Including support project management
Technical Representative

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:
Responsible for all technical information and specifications for each project including:
• Repair specifications, Inspection forms, drawings / prints, material specifications
• Respond to internal requests for inspection and budgetary repair work scopes
• Issue inspection work scopes and estimates
• Review inspection results and evaluate repair solutions
• Write repair work scopes and submit estimates
• Maintain/update repair and inspection service profile templates
• Provide engineering troubleshooting & solutions
• Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Engineering degree or at least 4 years’ experience in turbo machinery.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Jerome Blalack at Jerome.Blalack@sulzer.com or Hiring Manager – Billy Bottera.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A machinist needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Position Summary:

A Machinist is a professional that uses different techniques to create and make very precise metal parts. A machinist should be able to operate and maintain industrial machines, produce precision tools, interpret technical drawings and instructions, and ensure safety and quality standards. A machinist also needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Responsibilities:

Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Machine personnel, Supervisor, and Lead Man
Capable of setting up & operating all machines in the shop (including large mills, lathes, tool post grinders, and other equipment)
Operate manual and automatic feeds to 0.0002” as required for final cuts
Complete assigned jobs start to finish with little or no supervision. This includes the ability to perform the following:
Read blueprints, drawings and sketches that may require intermediate math and problems solving skills to calculate dimensions not specified on print.
Have and maintain ability to use and operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts
Maintain LEAN objectives within the department

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

Experience as a Manual machinist
Experience with both CNC with manual experience
Field machinist Manual Machinist

Work hours are subject to change & will be determined by workload and shift coverage needs. Typically, Day Shift will start at 5:00AM or 7am and end at 3:30PM; Typically, Night Shift will start at 3:30PM and will end at 12am or 2am.

jobs.title: Rotor Balance Tech
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts. Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for gas turbines. Rotor Balance Tech

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts.

• Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for Gas turbines.

• Read/interpret indicators accurately within .0001”. Read and understand the required technical information for the job. Properly complete all associated documentation required for their assignments.

• Continuously develop knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties. Complete company-required training programs .

• Communicate with co-workers, leads & supervisor on projects. Work well with other employees. Follow company Safety, Quality Policies, and ISO procedures.

• Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the schedule time . Keep work area clear and well organized during all phases of the project

• Comply with the requirements of risk assessments and safety procedures. Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Mechanical aptitude, reliability, integrity, teamwork & strong work ethic.

• Rotating equipment experience is preferred but not required.

• Balance experience is preferred but not required.

• Willing to work overtime.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
