jobs.title: Master Planner
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

target bonus: 16.67% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses.
- Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors.
- Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications.
- Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment.
- Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities.
- Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred.
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment.
- Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits.
- Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
- Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages.
- Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems.
- OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems.
- Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions.
- Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces.

Work Environment:
- Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations.
- May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations.

Key Competencies:
- Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills
- Attention to detail and safety awareness
- Strong communication and teamwork
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.en: Field Service Lead – Heavy Industrial Turbines
titleByLocale.fr: Lead Service Field – Turbines industrielles lourdes

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads the Field Service & Engineering organization with full responsibility for the planning, execution, and documentation of field jobs, services, and projects. The position ensures delivery in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and quality.
By leading the local center of competence, the role strengthens regional capabilities, reduces reliance on global mobilization, shortens response times, and ultimately enhances customer satisfaction and profitable service delivery.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead global field service execution, including outages, overhauls, inspections, troubleshooting, and commissioning

• Own global service performance, covering safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost, margins, and customer satisfaction

• Drive the regionalization of field services by developing local skills, certifications, tools, and standardized execution practices

• Define and implement the regional field service operating model in line with global policies and standards

• Act as the primary customer interface during service execution and support Sales & Tendering with execution concepts, feasibility reviews, and cost inputs

• Lead and develop local and regional Field Service Engineers and Supervisors, fostering a strong safety culture and service mindset

• Plan and optimize regional resources, coordinating cross‑regional support only where specialized expertise or peak capacity is required

• Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and compliance with global EHS and quality requirements, while feeding field learnings back into global organizations

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• 10+ years of experience in field service or service operations within turbomachinery, power generation, or rotating equipment

• Proven leadership experience managing multi‑disciplinary field service teams

• Strong background in outage execution, maintenance, and troubleshooting

• Experience with regionalization, localization, or operating model transformation is highly desirable

• Strong safety leadership, customer focus, and cost‑ and risk‑aware decision‑making skills

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: TS FS Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
To provide hands-on technical assistance in the repair and maintenance of various equipment in the workshop or at the customer sites. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Overhaul and repair of Various type of Turbine, gear boxes, pumps, compressors, and associated other equipment such auxiliary

• Installs rotating equipment including those requiring non-standard installation procedures. Make necessary alignment/adjustment to ensure correct operation.

• Removes & dismantles equipment with maintenance problems; cleans & lubricate; repairs/replace faulty components; reassembles units and checks for efficient operation. Performs preventive & breakdown maintenance jobs.

• Uses a variety of testing equipment to diagnose trouble in proper sequence. Also, uses tools such as hydraulic press, pullers, electric drills, grinders, heating torch as well as precision tools such as micrometer, caliper gauges & dial gauges for test-checking or repair work.

• Performs/ensures maintenance work in accordance with instructions, drawings and codes of practice.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?

• Requirement: minimum vocational high background: Automotive and Machining.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall maintenance. Familiar with measuring tools, and general tools.

• Familiar with Assembly drawing, symbols and legend.

• Familiar with relevant standard such as API, NEMA, codes, and rules of thumbs

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Fresh Graduate are welcome., 1–2-year experience in machinist role or automotive mechanic is preferred

• Production Knowledge: Precision Measuring tools/instrument such as Dial Gage, OD micrometres, ID micrometre, Callipers etc and math calculation.

• Familiar with Computer. Familiar with Drawing Software is a Plus. Hand Sketches is preferable.

• Proficient in English Language verbal and in written-Having certificate in English communication such as TOEIC is a plus.

• Basic Mechanical such as Lifting and Rigging, Metal and Alloys, Bearings, Welding, Production Processes and Shaft Alignment

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical Benefit Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium.

This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities.

If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer.

Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.

• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.

• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.

• Standardize key design features for the product range.

• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.

• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.

• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience

• Fluency in English and French

• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment

• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)

• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

What we offer you

• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth

• 36 days of annual leave

• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security

• Private health insurance for you and your family

• Meal vouchers daily

• Global career development opportunities, with exposure to international projects and mobility across the Sulzer network

• The chance to work in an innovative, agile, and vibrant culture where your ideas and impact truly matter

Have a question about the role? Reach out to the Hiring Manager – Claude Mockels or the recruiting team – Stéphanie Piron. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingenieur Qualite Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison).

Activités significatives :

Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes
- Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client.
- Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire.
- Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres.
- Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres.

Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication
- Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité.
- Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP).
- Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur.

Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire
- Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur.
- Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …).
- Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs.
- Vérification des documents qualité interne.
- Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités.
- Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration.

Après la livraison client
- Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI).
- Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties.

Compétences requises :

Compétences métier – technique

• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)

• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).

• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)

• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.

• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies

• IWE classique (soudure)

• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Anglais courant

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Maîtrise du code RCCM

• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)

• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)

• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

jobs.title: Sales Manager_South China
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of junior sales staff, ensuring daily sales operations run smoothly, and supporting the achievement of sales targets. This role provides coaching, monitors performance, and ensures compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities

• Develop pump services sales in south of China and achieve the sales target.

• Supervise daily activities of the sales team.

• Assign tasks and monitor progress toward goals.

• Ensure adherence to sales processes and policies.

• Handle customer issues and escalate when necessary.

• Track and report team performance.

• Support implementation of sales initiatives.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 5+ years of sales experience in pumps industry are minimally required.

• Good knowledge on pump technology and experience with pump service sales is preferred.

• Experience in sales or customer service supervision.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting.

• Problem-solving and organizational abilities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil.

In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.

• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)

• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).

• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;

• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;

• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.

• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;

• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)

• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role

• Excellent English. German and French are an asset

• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential

• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity

• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment

• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable.

What we offer you

• Attractive compensation and vacation plan

• Excellent social benefits

• Global development opportunities

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation

• Employee Assistance Program

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un tecnico/tecnico di laboratorio per unire il nostro team di applicazioni e tecnologie in Allschwil. In questo ruolo emozionante si pianifica ed eseguirà le prove dei clienti, nonché il supporto attivo sui progetti di ricerca e sviluppo interni (R&D). Condurrai diversi lavori pratici nel campo R&D per migliorare la sostenibilità nell'industria chimica e sviluppare le tecnologie future. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Analisi della caratterizzazione mediante tecniche chiave, tra cui: cromatografia a gas (GC) con campionamento a testa e liquido accoppiato a rilevatori di MS, FID e TCD; spettroscopia ottica a emissione plasmatica ad alte prestazioni (ICP-OES); spettrofotometria UV-Viss; spettrofotometria a scansione differenziale
• Responsabile del supporto analitico, garantendo l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione dei metodi e dell'operabilità dei dispositivi corrispondenti durante le prove (compresa la preparazione degli strumenti, la calibrazione esterna, la preparazione dei campioni e le misurazioni di routine)
• Pianificazione, esecuzione, valutazione e rendicontazione delle prove del cliente (scala del banco a scala pilota).
• Supporto nell'esecuzione di prove interne ed esterne per lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione delle tecnologie Sulzer;
• Lavoro in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali interni;
• Assicurare e rispettare adeguate misure di ESH e "buona pratica di laboratorio" durante il commercio quotidiano. Contribuire attivamente alla gestione dei cambiamenti e delle valutazioni dei rischi. Rispetta le norme di sicurezza e le procedure di qualità, segnala le mancanze, gli incidenti e gli incidenti. descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil. In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.
• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)
• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).
• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;
• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;
• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.
• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;
• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
• Excellent English. German and French are an asset
• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential
• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity
• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment
• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture
• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
Supports CAE activities for ORE, PD and CT projects globally. Compilation of mechanical analysis documentation provided to clients, proving the mechanical, rotordynamic and structural integrity of products, ensuring conformity to established industry, company standards and customer specifications

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Rotordynamic analysis (Lateral and Torsional) of centrifugal pumps.

• Pump design calculations as per international standards.

• Structural and Dynamic analysis of Baseplate and Vertical Pump using ANSYS Workbench

• Preparation & submission of calculation reports and coordinating for customer approvals.

• Provide technical assistance to project team to solve possible discrepancies & review and issue and follow-up the comments on reports, specifications, etc.

• Making design recommendations to provide acceptable rotordynamic level, behavior of pump and help to resolve difficult or unusual product design engineering problems.

• Capable of performing routine mechanical engineering calculations and analysis.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Relevant experience in Rotating machine industry practices & standards.

• Experience in finite element analysis techniques and calculations

• Experience of rotor dynamics, FEA using Ansys

• Solid understanding of structural mechanics fundamentals and basic vibration

• Knowledge of in 2D/3D CAD & PLM software

• Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, word and power point

• Knowledge of Industry Code & Standards such ASME, EN, API, etc

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

 Communication skills
 Relationship management skills
 Customer service skills
 Time management skills
 Ability to act independently
 Flexibility and ability to adapt to change
 Attention to detail
 Meet quality objectives set and KPIs

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero (formerly Alba Power) is a global leader in gas turbine maintenance, repair and overhaul, supporting critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Now part of Sulzer’s renowned rotating equipment services business, we combine decades of engineering expertise with a strong focus on supply chain excellence, partnering with suppliers to deliver quality, cost efficiency and reliability at scale.

We are currently looking for a Procurement Administrator to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to support a high-performing procurement function, managing supplier data, processing purchase orders and helping ensure smooth, efficient supply chain operations. Ideal for someone organised, detail-focused and keen to build a career in procurement within a global engineering business. Job Responsibilities

• Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.

• Maintain and update supplier information, including contact details, pricing agreements, and performance records.

• Assist in the preparation of Request for Quotations (RFQs) and Request for Proposals (RFPs), circulating them to potential suppliers.

• Track and expedite orders, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply chain issues or delays.

• Generate procurement reports, including spend analysis, supplier performance, and inventory levels.

• Support the negotiation of favorable terms and conditions with suppliers.

Job Qualifications

• Proven experience in an administrative or support role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.

• Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to task completion.

• Knowledge of procurement principles and practices is a plus.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: APT Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Application Engineering Lead is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, conducting technical analysis of product configurations, and ensuring customer-specific solutions meet technical and commercial requirements. This role includes preparing and delivering technical briefings, estimating costs and resources, and supporting implementation.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Prepare technical and commercial quotations; attend technical presentation and clarification meeting; technical appendix negotiation; attend commercial bidding and order negotiation, contract preparation / negotiation and risk control
• 2. Monitor / update project status in system regularly
• 3. Market Analysis and business promotion when needed
• 4. Internal handover meeting preparation
• 5. Assistant to attend column start up, plant test run and trouble shooting
• 6. Follow ISO procedure and Office 5s maintenance
• 7. Other tasks assigned by APT Manager/Team leader
• REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE
1. Minimum 1-3 years’ work experience as chemical engineer / plant engineer / process engineer in refinery, coal chemicals, environmental, petrochemicals, fine & specialty chemicals plant, with plant operation and DCS control practices will be more appreciated, or 1-3 years’ work experience as process engineer in engineering company in above mentioned market
• 2. Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, Master's degree is preferred
• 3. Fluent in both oral & written English and Mandarin
• 4. Fluent use MS office such as WORD /EXECL /PowerPoint
• 5. Fluent use simulation software such as Pro-II or Aspen would be additional benefit
• 6. Customer oriented, Teamwork in mind, Strong committed to achieve results
• 7. Positive attitude, Open-minded, Good communication skills
• 8. Ready to work under pressure. Available for frequent traveling
• 9. Awareness to work in an international environment

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Senior E&I Engineer, you will participate at the Sulzer projects execution at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support and et.) within discipline and responsible.
Senior E&I Engineer reports to the Chief E&I Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Execute detail engineering of instrument design for process plant modular skids, including wiring line diagrams, instruments, panel and PLC control specifications.

• Prepare technical specifications for inquiry, issuing requisition for instruments, related items and subcontracting work.

• Preparation and design of Piping and Instrumentation Diagram, in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Preparation of process plant operating control philosophy, including alarm and interlocking trip matrix in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Develop SIS, SIF and SIL

• Participate in HAZOP for process plant

• Review and approve subcontractor engineering documents, including instrument calculation, selection and PLC programming subcontractor.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Technical support for costing of skid projects.

• Support receiving inspection of project E&I items.

• Technical support for workshop skid assembly.

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management between disciplines

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Electrical/ Instrumentation Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Good knowledge of skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Ingegnere
titleByLocale.en: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Chaîne d'approvisionnement Management & Purchasing Ingénieur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

设置该岗位的目的:

The Senior SCM & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Identify and develop qualified best-fit suppliers for various demands of engineered equipment, materials, subcontracting need for Sulzer packages

• Conduct market research, TCO analysis (within Sulzer Scope coverage), and supply chain risk assessments.

• Support sourcing initiatives on product line development and source for the most cost‑effective sources.

• Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and supplier capabilities, lesson learns to support team innovation

• Vendor Management

• Evaluate, qualify, and assess suppliers' technical capability, quality standards, and capacity Manage supplier performance, conduct audits, and drive corrective actions where needed. Maintain accurate supplier records (credentials, ISO, Financial, audit records, performance in Sulzer digital dashboard, and other files. Support Quality team in the corrective actions for in case of NCR and tracking of COPQ

• Project Procurement Support (when activated)

• Will be working in Advanced Procurement team while collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Workshop to meet project procurement needs and timelines. Provide regular procurement status reports, risk assessments, and mitigation plans. Manage end-to-end procurement cycle including RFQ’s, commercial bid evaluations. Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, favorable terms, while aligned to the total cost of ownership (within Sulzer scope). Issue purchase orders, monitor order progress for buy outs, work with Quality and Project Manag

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, specialising in OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industrial applications. This site brings together cutting-edge engineering capability, digital design, and high-precision manufacturing, supporting sectors such as energy, water, chemicals, and infrastructure.

With significant recent investment, our Leeds operations are evolving rapidly—enhancing our capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing, and product innovation. This is where new business pumps are brought to life from cradle to grave—from initial concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery, and lifecycle support. We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value pump projects within our new business portfolio. You will play a critical role in managing the end-to-end project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and manage multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle – from bid handover through design, manufacturing, and final delivery

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring strong relationships and clear communication

• Drive project planning, scheduling, risk management, and cost control

• Coordinate cross-functional teams including design engineering, production, procurement, and quality

• Ensure compliance with contractual, technical, and regulatory requirements

• Identify and manage risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as a Project Manager within engineering, manufacturing, or OEM environments

• Strong knowledge of complex mechanical equipment, ideally pumps or rotating equipment

• Demonstrated experience delivering high-value, technically complex projects

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Strong commercial awareness, including budget control and contract management

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment

• Project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP) desirable

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• Competitive base salary

• Annual bonus, based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance through Aviva

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Aero Mechanic is responsible for the safe coordination of assembly and disassembly of all aero derivative machinery. They inspect and diagnose malfunctions and reliably fix machinery in compliance with safety regulations. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble power turbines, gas generators, and accessory gear associated with aeroderivative machinery

• Possess a proficient knowhow of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments.

• Continuously gain knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties including updating safety processes.

• Keep the work areas clean and well-organized during disassembly, inspection, assembly, and when the job is completed.

• Be ready to travel to job site when called with tools and safety equipment.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• Hands-on shop and/or field service experience in aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• Technical knowledge of aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• 4+ years of aeroderivative machinery experience is preferred but not required.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large, Group organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Follow instructions and complete assigned duties.
Participate in training and development activities.
Support team members as needed.

POSITION: Mechanical Design Intern

DEPARTMENT: Product Engineering
SUPERVISOR: Supervisor Pump Design
SALARY GRADE: N/A
FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt
SUMMARY:

The Product Development (PD) group is involved in the design, validation and documentation of new product design and upgrades to existing product ranges. The successful candidate will work on project support as assigned by Engineers in the PD group.

Position is full-time during the summer.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
% OF TIME

Training will be given to accomplish the following:

· Hands-on support of component testing and data collection.
· Drafting support using NX 3D/2D system
· Engineering support work for projects as assigned
· Release of drawings / documents through SAP & Teamcenter ERP systems

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
· Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide ESG & EHS Management systems, which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
· Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of freshman year of BSc Mechanical Engineering degree.
· Excellent interpersonal, communication and analytical skills.
· Sound computer skills in Word and Excel.
· Experience with 2D and 3D CAD systems
· An Interest in rotating machinery and manufacturing is beneficial.

What we offer you

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Manufacturing Quality Inspector is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs. This role ensures compliance with internal and regulatory standards and supports the timely delivery of quality products.
This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. SUMMARY: Performs receipt and in-process dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies. Create and record inspection results on appropriate inspection report using Microsoft Excel and Word. Reviews sub-contractor procedures and reports; and maintains department records and procedures for current code requirements. Position functions independently with occasional guidance from the Quality Assurance Manager.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

% OF TIME

60% Performs dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies in accordance with appropriate specifications.

10% Monitors for compliance to processes and procedures.

10% Communicate with manufacturing personnel concerning priority of inspection.

10% Perform surveillance activities at Supplier facilities to determine compliance and acceptability of equipment/process being supplied.

10% Interfaces with 3rd party and Customer inspectors as required.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILIES

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in EHS Management System, including following safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Sulzer procedure review and implementation assistance.

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Regular and reliable attendance with flexible work habits and schedule.

• Performs other duties as necessary

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

• ASNT Certification for NDE Level I or Level II for PT, MT, UT and/or VT, preferred.

• Proficient in Microsoft and SAP applications

• Ability to read and interpret drawings, procedures, and specifications, define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions

• Understanding appropriate application of inspection techniques

• Working knowledge of ASME, ASTM, AWS and other relative codes, preferred.

• Good written and oral communication, organizational skills, and ability to perform basic math.

• High School Diploma required.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Manager is responsible for managing a team of mechanical engineers, overseeing the design and development of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures the implementation of engineering strategies and influences technical practices.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of more senior expert-level employees (P20–P40, M20). Activities in charge:

• Manage the team that performs hydraulic and functional tests for centrifugal pumps

• Ensure that area safety guidelines are met

• Attention and follow-up with clients to provide technical support

• Implementation of continuous improvement projects

• Development of strategies for cost reduction, optimization, and productivity

• KPI's management

• Collaborate with the company's vision to achieve objectives

Requirements:

• Bachelors in engineering.

• Experience in metalworking, electrical, electronics.

• +5 years in management roles

• Previous experience in rotodynamic equipment

jobs.title: NDT Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The NDT Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities

• Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.

• Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.

• Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.

• Document inspection results and report deviations.

• Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

• Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.

• Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.

• Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.

• Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.

• Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Jr. Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Production Worker / Technician is responsible for supporting the assembly and testing of products in a manufacturing environment. This role performs basic tasks under supervision and contributes to maintaining production quality and efficiency.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in assembling and testing products.
Follow safety and quality procedures.
Report defects and support troubleshooting.
Maintain tools and workstations.
Document production activities.
Learn and apply production techniques.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Basic technical and mechanical skills.
Willingness to learn and follow procedures.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Attention to detail and safety awareness.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Welder nightshift
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. Responsibilities

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• Knowledge and understand of turbo machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 5 years or more of proven welding experience.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student, Apprentice, or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. SUMMARY:
The Engineering Intern works closely with the engineering department to assist with technical projects, design tasks, manufacturing processes, analysis, and documentation to gain practical, hands-on industry experience in nuclear rotating equipment design, manufacturing, and refurbishment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTION:

• Provide technical support for projects, including design, testing, and engineering calculations.

• Assist in creating and modifying drawings or models using CAD software.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Assist in creating technical reports, manuals, and documentation for projects.

• Interface with cross-functional teams (quality, manufacturing) to solve problems.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Currently enrolled as a Junior or Senior in an accredited B.S. program in Mechanical Engineering.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 401k with 6% company match

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. JOB SUMMARY:
The Tendering & Purchasing Specialist is responsible for managing the end‑to‑end tendering, sourcing, and purchasing activities for materials, components, and services used in the manufacture of safety‑related and non‑safety‑related nuclear power plant parts. This role ensures compliance with stringent nuclear quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures while achieving cost, quality, and delivery objectives. The ideal candidate must have the ability to interpret Bills of Materials (BOMs) and technical drawings to accurately estimate costs and prepare proposals. This role requires close collaboration with sales, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to develop winning submissions and support business growth.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Prepare and manage RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders
· Evaluate supplier offers for commercial, technical, and quality compliance
· Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms
· Ensure adherence to nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
· Coordinate with engineering, quality, and production teams
· Track orders, expedite deliveries, and resolve supplier issues

SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Keep department manager apprised of future opportunities.

• Advise management of changes in current order and tender status.

• Actively involved with standardization and continuous improvement processes.

• Maintain quote and order files.

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and QESH Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in tendering, purchasing, cost estimation, or bid management in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

• Proficiency in reading and interpreting BOMs and technical drawings.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and cost structures.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP), SalesForce and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) preferred but not required.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.

• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

What we offer you

Country Benefits:

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
