jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Specialist is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This role ensures that proposals are technically accurate and aligned with company standards.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.

Position Summary:

The Commercial Specialist (CS) has broad responsibilities related to cost estimation, customer service and sales. As business professional the primary function of the CS is to build key relationships with CS peers, Local/Regional/Global Sales Managers, with Operations, with Projects and customers. Essentially, they are the central hub between all departments with the organization for Proposal management. They are responsible for executing or supporting the business processes between those groups efficiently, consistently and with clear communication. The CS is a key role for the organization that allows interaction with all aspects of the business and is a great position for anyone with experience or someone with the positive attitude willing to learn. This position extends the opportunity to learn our business within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical and Power Generation industries.

CSs have duties and responsibilities in the following areas:

Proposal Management
The Commercial Specialist is primarily responsible for the generation and on-time submission of proposals to the customer. The Commercial Specialist coordinates and communicates with all necessary stakeholders to ensure submission of proposals. During the proposal process Commercial Specialist serves as liaison between customer, projects and operations for any commercial and/or technical clarification.
Responsibilities:

• Responsible for executing the proposal generation process within the Business Management System and with “First time right approach”

• Revise or create proposals based upon needs of the customer and handle any necessary clarifications

• Pro-active role in driving the proposal management by managing all technical and commercial risks with support of other stakeholders

• Ensure all proposals are reviewed per Sulzer’s internal delegation of authority and create the opportunity specific calculations

• Manage the storage / archiving of the proposals and related information

• Screening of the Terms and Conditions and coordination of the review and modification of T&C’s with Legal and Commercial managers

• Support the regional/local/global sales team in all commercial matters to achieve the projects.

jobs.title: Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are hiring a Pump Mechanic full time, day shift. You will be responsible for repairing and maintaining Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Job Responsibilities:

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications:

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Pump repair experience preferred

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Support (Aftermarket)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support will be responsible for supporting FRC Wastewater treatment systems after they have been commissioned for operation. You will be responsible for proactively reaching out to customers to ensure they have a stock of spare parts. You will assist customers with ordering spare parts and answering questions about performance or technical issues.
Essential Functions: (80%)

• Call customers with FRC equipment to assist them with ordering spare parts.

• Assemble detailed project specific spare parts list, provide to Project Manager.

• Respond to customer questions regarding spare parts and upgrades.

• Function as entry point for questions from customers and sales representatives regarding technical and performance questions for installations provided by FRC.

• Follow up to confirm customer questions have been answered.

• When required, forward questions to the right person within organization and ensure adherence to FRC's 24-hour response philosophy.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, FRC representatives, consultants, engineers and managers through responsive, effective and honest communications.

• Proactive communication with customers about the need for and functionality of spare parts, (Discontinued items, Upgrades, etc.)

• Contact vendors for specific project/non-standard part quotes.

• Generate Spare parts quotes for customers.

• Calculate the mark-up of the spare parts, based on the margin schedule.

• Create and Process sales Orders on Purchase orders received for Spare Parts.

• Organize / Process customer's order shipment details.

Secondary Functions: (20%)

• Capture and maintain detailed notes related to customer contacts, conversations about spares, warranty issues, and upgrades.

• Prepare a monthly report providing a structured overview of all documented notes and communications concerning spares, warranty matters, and system upgrades.

• Coordinate with QA/Logistics manager and Project Manager(s) to resolve warranty complaints.

Qualifications:

• 2-year technical diploma or degree

• or

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a related industrial field (mechanical/manufacturing)

• Preferable experience with shipping

Key Skills, Knowledge and Competencies:

• Proficient computer skills: Microsoft Office, knowledge of an inventory / bookkeeping program, and online freight management (i.e., UPS, FedEx).

• A strong customer focus is essential, working with both internal and external customers.

• Fluent English skills verbally and written.

• Mechanical aptitude.

• Preferable basic mechanical and/or electrical knowledge.

• Highly self-motivated

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to listen and understand others.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster strong working relationships.

• Ability to work independently and follow through on work assignments with minimal direction.

• Detail oriented.

• Positive attitude towards change and growth

• Has cultural flexibility. Is capable to deal with the different corporate cultures and cultures of production plants of FRC's clients.

• Is allowed to legally work in the U.S.

Environmental, safety & health requirements:

• Complies with QESH policy

• Complies and participates with SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Performs its functions following and understanding the Job Safety Analysis (JSA), is aware of the workplace hazards

• Avoids and reports unsafe behaviors and unsafe conditions

• Uses and maintains personal protective equipment

• Reports accidents and near accidents

• Complies with environmental and safety rules, policies, work instructions, manuals, etc.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist - Turbine Repair Shop

titleByLocale.it: Macchinista manuale - Negozio di riparazione turbina
titleByLocale.fr: Machiniste manuel - atelier de réparation de turbines

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts.

Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

Country-specific benefits

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.
• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.
• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.
• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).
• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.
• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.
• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.
• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment. Required Qualifications
• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .
• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.
• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.
• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.
• Must supply basic personal hand tools. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.
• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.
• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.
• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components. Competencies
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.
• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices. What we offer you Country-specific benefits
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities

• Follow safety and quality procedures.

• Report defects and support troubleshooting.

jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Business Controller will serve as the primary financial liaison between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key
financial and project management activities. Also ensure seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial processes.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate tracking and management of sales and backlogs

• Monitor customer order contract profitability and utilization metrics

• Link strategic plans to operational and financial drivers, aligning sales and operations planning, resource management, capital projects, other expenses, and working capital planning.

• Generate, model, and execute action plans to address performance gaps and improve overall site performance

• Provide business planning, forecasting, and budgeting know how and support to the relevant stakeholders

• Supervision and coordination of tasks with the Coe & BPO team.

• Variance analysis

• Responsible for managing internal reports.

• Support to the Head Office on financial matters.

What you need you to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Controlling

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• Experience within the manufacturing sectors is preferred

• Strong Knowledge of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning

• Excellent communication skills to liaise between local operations, BPO and CoE

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Capacity to remain flexible and effective when facing challenges

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Used to work with databases and reporting tools

• Proficiency in English (C1)

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Rivas (Madrid)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Journeylevel Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Assembly Mechanic will be responsible for backfiling and balancing impellers, installing pump components, performing hydrostatic tests, installing pumps into test pit, and assembling full pumps for shipments. Other duties may be required as assigned by the Supervisor. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Using common hand, air, and power tools, assemble horizontal and vertical pumps per Engineering Instructions, Drawings, and Work Orders.

• Disassemble and inspect pumps for repairs.

• Perform hot work for installation of subcomponents.

• Coordinate work with other Assembly Mechanics, and shop personal to assists them in accomplishing tasks.

• Resolves issues with work instructions to shop, includes interfacing with engineering, purchasing, quality, planning, and project coordinators.

• Perform grinding operations and balancing on pump impellers.

• Regular and reliable attendance.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Recommended 5 years experience in related environment, preferably working with pumps

• Ability to communicate effectively both written and orally

• Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

jobs.title: CNC Mill Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate machinery according to instructions.
Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments.
Inspect products for quality and report defects.
Maintain a clean and safe work area.
Record production data and report issues.
Follow safety and operational procedures.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic mechanical skills and attention to detail.
Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines.
Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina.
Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.
Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: HR Project Manager – Localization & Workforce Strategy

titleByLocale.it: Risorse Umane Project Manager – Localization & Workforce Strategy
titleByLocale.en: HR Project Manager – Localization & Workforce Strategy
titleByLocale.de: Personalwesen Project Manager – Localization & Workforce Strategy
titleByLocale.fr: Ressources Humaines Project Manager – Localization & Workforce Strategy

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Project Manager responsible for supporting and executing strategic HR initiatives across the region, including organizational transformation, talent management, and process optimization. Partners closely with HR Heads to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure alignment with business objectives. Drives continuous improvement through data-driven insights, change management, and effective communication, ensuring successful implementation of HR programs that enhance operational efficiency. Main accountabilities:

• End to end delivery & project plans, timelines, and tracking/reporting mechanisms for regional HR programs highlighting risks, and outcomes to the HR Heads. Collaborate with country HR teams across the region to support alignment and knowledge sharing, across the region and divisions.

• Support regional localization initiatives, with a focus on focus on KSA and contribution to regional localization objectives but extend across the GCC as required.

• Track and consolidate localization metrics & ratios, Nitaqat/ Emiratization/ Bahrainization status, and related KPIs for regional reporting as well as analyzing trends and providing insights and recommendations.

• Ensure accurate documentation and reporting to meet MEC regional regulatory and training requirements.

• Coordinate the execution of regional learning and development initiatives across MEC, including supporting to implement the training cross divisionally & ensuring alignment with local localization needs and Global practices ensuring effective adoption / embedding.

• Generate insights and data collection, including reporting for HR Heads for SWP, succession planning & performance.

• Support Employee engagement initiatives, and communications/follow ups (surveys, feedback activities, employee engagement (VOS)) and collate data insights for HR Leadership.

• Act as a regional point of coordination for cross country HR initiatives (Culture transformation, Summer Internships etc.), ensuring consistency in implementation and in line with local regulatory requirements.

• Support regional workforce localization planning (Strategic Workforce planning) through data analysis, coordination, and implementation

• Support with data and reporting for succession planning and performance, to support the HR Heads in people reviews and SWP.

Desired experience and qualifications
7+ years experience in Human resources. Strong HR project management and regional coordination experience. Data analytics and stakeholder management.
Degree in Human Resources or a related field.
Languages: English and Arabic

Soft skills:

• Strong understanding of localizations laws in the region and regional HR operational procedures, strong project management skills.

• Ability to work independently in a matrix organization

• Cultural awareness across GCC region

• Attention to detail and strong influencing skills

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Problem-solving and analytical skills

• Resource management skills

• Strong ownership mindset

• Collaborative

What we offer you

As per local requirements

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This role is responsible for delivering technical support to Sales and Tendering teams by reviewing pump selections, evaluating client requirements, and coordinating with internal teams, suppliers, and global entities. The role involves preparing preliminary designs, supporting costing and bidding activities, and contributing to technical evaluations, including risk identification and mitigation.
This position is suited for experienced professionals with strong knowledge of pump design, development, and selection, who apply their expertise to provide effective technical solutions. Proposed solutions are typically reviewed and validated in collaboration with senior team members.
• Provide technical support to the Sales and Tendering teams throughout the bidding process.

• Review pump selections prepared by the Tendering team to ensure technical compliance and optimization.

• Review and interpret client specifications, particularly for critical or special requirements.

• Coordinate with the Design Responsible (DR) team to obtain additional technical inputs and solutions.

• Interact directly with customers to understand specific application needs and incorporate them into the design layout.

• Liaise with suppliers to resolve technical queries and obtain necessary clarifications.

jobs.title: Workshop Support Assistant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Workshop Support Assistant is responsible for supporting the assembly and testing of products in a manufacturing environment. This role performs basic tasks under supervision and contributes to maintaining production quality and efficiency.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key 
• Responsibilities
Assist in assembling and testing products.
Follow safety and quality procedures.
Report defects and support troubleshooting.
Maintain tools and workstations.
Document production activities.
Learn and apply production techniques.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Technical skills required:
Basic technical and mechanical skills.
Willingness to learn and follow procedures.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Attention to detail and safety awareness.

As per local regulations

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This is a hands-on role to liaise and support customers with onsite repairs and service, together with the Supervision of field services personnel, ensuring the day-to-day safe and efficient running of the assigned area.
• Dismantle, Inspection, machining, repair and rebuilding of both Sulzer and non-Sulzer rotating equipment

• Field service repairs and/or overhauls in both workshop and client locations

• Supervision of subcontractors, from time to time

• Liaising with customers to compile job reports and represent Sulzer in all aspects of rotating equipment services.

• Assist in the production and maintenance of the OSH, Quality and Environment policies and procedures

• Assist in implementing and maintaining ISO accreditation

• Interpreting engineering drawings

• Balancing of rotating Equipment, and Alignment of pumps, motors etc.

• Machining of components

Education requirements

• Trade Qualification in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.

Key skills / Experience / Role Requirement

• 5+ years’ experience with Electrical / Mechanical products.

• Field Service Experience

• Strong communication skills.

• High level skills in time management.

• Ability to engage and work with others.

• Travel ~ >50% of time.

Language skills

• Fluent in written and spoken English is a must.

jobs.title: Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The repair of electrical rotating machinery and associated equipment. QESH – Adhere to the Company QESH systems within Workshop / Dept to complete projects / Tasks and actively promote a clean and safe work environment at all times. Report all risks, near misses and Incidents to line manager and in Quality system.
Corporate Policies & Directives – Follow and adhere to all Company and SC policy requirements as directed by SC Management.
Behaviors - Demonstrate and promote, Sulzer Values and Behaviors; Policy; Processes. Good team members, promoting positive interpersonal relationships within team and across teams, support Sulzer’s strategic direction, and positive communication.
Continuous Improvement – Support SC management and Sulzer with implementation and continuation of LEAN initiatives within the Department.
Planning – Ensure planning of workshop projects in on schedule and to time budget

Skills / Role Responsibilities -

• The repair of LV & HV electrical rotating machinery

• Assemble and disassemble electrical rotating equipment

• Conduct static and dynamic tests to electrical equipment

• Rewind electric motors and generators (desirable)

• Perform Balancing on Motors (desirable)

• Perform EX (explosive atmosphere) works (desirable)

• Goods ordering when required

• Take direction from Supervisor to ensure day to day section runs effectively

• Attend onsite to effectively conduct repair of electrical rotating equipment

• Housekeeping duties as required

• National and international travel when required, sometimes at short notice

Education requirements

• CERT III in Electrotechnology or above / equivalent

• State issues Electrical License/permit

Key skills / Experience / Role Requirement

• Experience in repair and rewind of DC motors, medium to High Voltage electrical motors and generators,

• Attention to detail

• High level of communication skills.

• Good level of time management.

• Ability to engage and work with others.

• Dedication to working in a safe manner at all times

Language skills

• English

What we offer you

TBD

jobs.title: Production Shift Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Officer is responsible for supporting daily production or service operations by coordinating schedules, monitoring progress, and ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Description: Packaging Shift Engineer
Position Title
Packaging Shift Engineer
Function
Operations – Packaging Work Center
Reporting To
Packaging Manager
Experience Requirement
5–7 years of experience in Packaging / Production operations with shift-handling responsibility

Key Responsibilities
1. Production & Shift Operations

• Plan and execute packaging activities as per monthly production plans and inspection schedules.

• Deploy manpower effectively based on shift workload and packaging requirements.

• Monitor production orders, confirm job execution, and ensure on‑time package completion.

• Plan activities considering space availability and readiness for upcoming orders.

• Coordinate piping, wiring, and overall package readiness as per drawings and customer requirements.

2. Manpower Supervision & Workforce Management

• Supervise operators and technicians during shift operations.

• Provide on‑the‑job technical guidance and resolve shop‑floor issues.

• Conduct toolbox talks at the beginning of each shift.

• Motivate the workforce to maintain high standards of productivity, discipline, safety, and quality.
3. Quality Assurance & NCR Management

• Offer completed jobs to Quality Control and support inspection activities.

• Attend inspections and close all punch points for package readiness.

• Raise and manage NCRs (internal & external) and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.

• Implement in‑house rework solutions to minimize outsourcing and delays.

• Drive adherence to Zero NCR targets for the packaging department.

• undefined
4. Subcontracting & In‑Process Activities

• Plan, coordinate, and follow up on subcontracted activities, including:
• Blasting & Painting

• Piping fabrication and hydro testing

• Radiography Testing (RT)

• Pump Insulation

• Ensure subcontracted work meets quality, safety, and delivery commitments.

5. Materials, Consumables & Cross‑Functional Coordination

• Identify shortages in materials and consumables.

• Coordinate with Stores, Warehouse, Purchase, Planning teams for timely availability.

• Prepare consumable requirement forecasts and follow up for procurement.

• Coordinate maintenance activities during breakdowns to minimize downtime.

• Ensure calibrated tools and gauges are submitted to QC as per schedule.

6. Productivity & Performance Monitoring

• Maintain and review JCP (Job Capacity Planning) monthly.

• Ensure effective and optimal manpower utilization.

• Monitor execution of paperless production systems.

• Ensure accurate confirmation of production hours and SAP entries.

• undefined
7. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices, including:
• 5S

• Kaizen

• Continuous Improvement initiatives

• Submit Kaizen proposals monthly and motivate employees to contribute improvement ideas.

• Conduct and participate in periodic 5S audits.

• Drive digital and paperless systems across packaging operations.
8. Training & Skill Development

• Identify training needs and conduct skill development programs for shop‑floor personnel.

• Support capability building to improve safety, quality, and productivity.
9. Safety, Health & Environment (ESH)

• Ensure strict adherence to safety policies and PPE usage.

• Conduct regular safe

jobs.title: Temporary Document Assistant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. Summary
The Temporary Document Assistant provides administrative support by organizing, filing, scanning, and maintaining company documents and records. This entry-level position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and able to handle confidential information professionally.

Key Responsibilities

Follow instructions and complete assigned duties
Support team members as needed
File paper and electronic documents in an organized and accurate manner
Scan, upload, and index documents into company systems
Organize and maintain business records.
Retrieve files and documents as requested
Ensure records are complete, accurate, and properly stored
Assist with record retention and document clean-up projects
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company and employee information
Perform other administrative and clerical duties as assigned
Regular and reliable attendance

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent required
Previous office or administrative experience preferred but not required
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion
Ability to work independently and manage routine tasks

Physical Requirements
Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 25 pounds as needed
Ability to work with paper files and office equipment, including scanners and copiers

Schedule
Full time / Temporary position

What we offer you

• Company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Record to Report accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in advanced pump design and manufacturing. From energy and water to chemicals and industrial markets, we support critical infrastructure and essential industries worldwide. With over 13,500 employees globally, a CHF 3.5 billion turnover, and shares listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange, Sulzer combines global scale with local expertise. Our Leeds facility sits at the heart of our engineering excellence delivering complex, high-value solutions to customers across the UK and beyond.

We are looking for a commercially astute Business Controller to join our Leeds operation. This is not a traditional reporting role, we need a true finance business partner—someone who will sit alongside senior stakeholders, challenge thinking, influence decisions and actively shape the commercial and operational performance of the business.
Key Responsibilities

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing strategic and operational decisions

• Provide clear, actionable financial insights to drive profitability, efficiency and growth

• Partner closely with operations, sales, and engineering to support large, complex projects

• Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes

• Analyse order intake, margins, cost structures, and working capital performance

• Identify risks and opportunities, ensuring robust financial control

• Drive continuous improvement across finance systems and processes

• Support investment decisions and business cases

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as a Business Controller / Finance Business Partner in a manufacturing or engineering environment

• Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders

• Experience supporting high-value, complex operations

• Advanced knowledge of SAP and strong data analysis capability

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent)

• A proactive, hands-on mindset with the ability to operate both strategically and tactically

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• Annual bonus scheme linked to personal and company performance.

• Private medical insurance (individual cover through Aviva)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Working Pattern
Due to the nature of the role, regular onsite presence in Leeds is required. That said, we take a mature and flexible approach to ways of working, recognising the importance of balance and autonomy. Occasional home working can therefore be supported where appropriate, although this is not a fully hybrid role. We also offer a flexi-time policy, enabl

jobs.title: Equipment Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Equipment Service Technician provides first level customer support for rental units deployed in the field. You will test, diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and debug electro-mechanical processing equipment and related systems. You must be able to communication and to work closely with Engineering, Project Management, and other Field Technicians on complex problems and assume responsibilities for continued customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites to assist with installation, start-up, servicing/repairing Wastewater Treatment Equipment (WWTE) and related sub-systems, and Operator training.
Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Assist the Service Technician at FRC2 with the refurbishment of rental units.

• Able and willing to travel 50% to 60% of the time to perform service-related tasks at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot a variety of Industrial WWTE and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.

• Assist customers on the phone and/or in the field with troubleshooting equipment.

• Prepare detailed reports related to site visits, equipment problems/concerns/recommendations.

• Adhere to safety policies and use of safety equipment.

• Adhere to Corporate credit card and travel procedures.

• Position requires the ability to work extensive hours outdoors in sometimes less than ideal situations (adverse weather, noise, and possibly wet conditions)

• Physical Demand – Move and/or lift up to 50lbs, constant movement – standing, climbing, and walking.

• FRC is a Drug-Free Workplace, Employment subject to passing a drug test.

Education

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Sulzer Pump Services is looking for a Supply Chain Manager to manage 12 locations nationwide. You will be responsible for setting up, supporting, and continuous improvement of the Pump Services Product Line and its supply chain management program.
• Identifying and managing relationships with suppliers, negotiating contracts, and ensuring the timely acquisition of raw materials and components.

• Coordinating the transportation, warehousing, and storage of goods to ensure they reach their destinations efficiently and cost-effectively.

• Maintaining appropriate stock levels of materials and finished products, analyzing inventory data, and ensuring enough supplies are available for production and customer orders.

• Forecasting demand, planning production schedules, and coordinating with manufacturing teams to align output with market needs.

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and customers to ensure smooth collaboration and address issues.

• Continuously reviewing and analyzing existing logistical functions and processes to identify areas for improvement and developing policies to increase efficiency.

• Identifying and implementing strategies to minimize costs throughout the supply chain, from sourcing to delivery.

• Streamlining processes and optimizing resource allocation to increase output and improve overall operational performance.

• Ensuring timely and reliable delivery of products to customers, which contributes to a positive customer experience.

• Utilizing performance data and analytics to make informed decisions and guide strategies for improvement.

• Identifying potential issues within the supply chain, such as supply disruptions or sudden spikes in demand, and developing strategies to mitigate these risks.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar technical degree OR

• Bachelor’s degree in business relevant to supply chain, vendor management, business analysis

• 5 Years relevant experience in manufacturing with supply chain management and business analysis responsibilities

• Minimum of 5- year P&L responsibility

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Head of HR - SEA Cluster
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Director is responsible for leading HR strategy and operations for a business unit or function. This role supports organizational goals through effective talent management, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3–5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1–3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business goals supporting 3 divisions across multiple countries in the region
- Lead talent acquisition, development, and retention efforts.
- Oversee payroll, compensation, benefits, and performance management.
- Lead labor cost budgeting process across multiple countries in the region.
- Partner with Legal Counsel to drive compliance culture.
- Ensure compliance with HR policies and labor laws.
- Partner with leadership to drive organizational effectiveness.
- Lead HR projects to improve in operational performance.
- Lead a team of HR professionals in the region.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Requires a minimum of 8 - 10 years of relevant working experience in a similar industry in managerial capacity.
- A degree in relevant field such as business management or Human Resources is preferred.
- Strong HR leadership and strategic planning experience.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to lead HR teams and initiatives.
- Able to multi-task and detail oriented.

What we offer you

Fixed Transport Allowance, Bi-yearly heathy lifestyle incentive and enrichment allowance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To establish and maintain financial and management procedures for Sulzer entities in Libya ensuring compliance with all internal standards, controls and implementing best practice whilst meeting internal customer satisfaction goals and the company’s overall corporate strategy 1. Lead the legal entity as a Finance business partner / LE Finance head.
2. Plan, develop and implement Finance strategy ensuring that it meets overall corporate needs and departmental KPI.
3. Support business partner in developing entity’s strategies by providing recommendations to strategically enhance financial performance and business opportunities.
4. Responsible for end-to-end accounting for the legal entity including the banking transactions.
5. Responsible for compliance and Internal Control Systems (ICS) for legal entity.
6. Responsible for reviewing contracts with legal & doing Financial due diligence reviews for all agents (If any).
7. Responsible for monthly forecasts, monthly reporting, annual budgets, Internal and External audits for legal entity.
8. Analyse financial results, identify and communicate deviations from forecasts with recommendations for solutions and improvements.
9. Responsible for Accounts Receivable & collections.
10. Review and analysis of the Operating Cashflow & forecasting
11. Responsible for tracking Work in Progress, backlog, order wise profitability and monthly regular reconciliation of WIP Vs backlog.
12. Participate and drive the continuous improvement of financial processes, business processes and ERP systems.
Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting support to senior management

Qualifications/Experience:

• CA/ACCA/CPA/CIMA or equivalent qualification.

• SAP experience

• 7+ years relevant experience

• Treasury Management experience

• Advanced Excel skills

• General computer skills

Competencies:

• Communication skills

• Team working skills

• Organisation skills

• Ability to act independently

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change

• Attention to detail

What we offer you

To be discussed as part of the interview process

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: RB211 Agent de formation des turbines à gaz

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced RB211 Gas Turbine Training Officer to support our growing MRO operations. This is a fantastic internal opportunity for a time-served, hands-on RB211 specialist who is passionate about developing others and driving technical excellence across our workforce.
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced RB211 Gas Turbine Training Officer to support our growing MRO operations. This is a fantastic internal opportunity for a time-served, hands-on RB211 specialist who is passionate about developing others and driving technical excellence across our workforce.
Department
Engineering / Field Service / Operations Training

Location
Aberdeen (Netherley) / On-site

Reports To
Operations Manager

Role Purpose

To design, deliver, and continuously improve training programmes focused on the RB211 gas turbine , ensuring personnel are competent, compliant, and capable in the strip, inspect, build and troubleshooting of the equipment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Training Delivery

• Deliver classroom and practical training on:

• RB211 gas turbine systems and components

• Strip , inspect, build and operation, maintenance, and fault diagnosis

• Health, Safety & Environmental procedures

• Conduct hands-on training in workshop and field environments

• Assess trainee competency through tests, practical evaluations, and observations

2. Course Development & Material Management

• Develop and maintain structured training package, including:

• Training manuals

• Presentations and technical guides Assessment tools

• Ensure training content is:

• Technically accurate

• Aligned with Sulzer standards

• Updated to reflect operational feedback and modifications

3. Competency & Compliance

• Maintain competency matrices for personnel working on RB211 units

• Ensure all training meets: Company standards & Regulatory requirements (client-specific)

• Support audits and provide training records as required

4. Technical Support & Knowledge Transfer

• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for RB211 gas turbines

• Support operations and maintenance teams with, Technical queries & Fault investigations

• Capture lessons learned from field activities and integrate into training

5. Continuous Improvement

• Gather feedback from trainees and operations teams

• Identify gaps in knowledge, skills, or training delivery

• Drive improvements in training efficiency, effectiveness, and engagement

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Strong working knowledge of RB211 gas turbine systems

• Experience in turbine maintenance, overhaul, or field service

• Previous experience delivering or supporting technical training

• Relevant engineering qualification (e.g. HNC/HND or equivalent experience)

Desirable

• Formal training/assessor qualification (e.g. Train the Trainer, A1 Assessor)

• Experience in offshore or oil & gas environments

• Familiarity with competency management systems

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Ability to simplify complex technical information

• Strong organisational and documentation skills

• Analytical approach to problem-solving

• High attention to detail and safety focus

Working Conditions

• Combination of classroom, workshop, and field-based training

• Occasional travel to client sites may be required to assist with enigne installation/removal and troubleshooting

• Flexible working to support operational demands

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and ph

jobs.title: Proposal Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a leading independent electromechanical and rotating equipment service provider, delivering maintenance, repair, overhaul, and engineered solutions across critical industries. With 14 UK service centres and access to a global network, we offer fast, expert support for pumps, motors, turbines, compressors, generators and more. We operate across essential markets including water & wastewater, energy, chemicals, marine, industrial manufacturing and renewables.

We are now looking for a Proposals Specialist to join our UK & Nordics Commercial Operations team. This role has become available following the retirement of a long‑serving colleague, offering a fantastic opportunity to step into an established and valued position with real impact across the business. In this role, you will play a key part in managing and developing our spares offering across the network, leading the preparation and delivery of high‑quality quotations that are accurate, competitive and aligned with customer requirements.

What you’ll be doing

• Owning the full enquiry and quotation process—from qualification through to final submission

• Acting as the key point of contact for internal teams and customers throughout the bid lifecycle

• Structuring, refining and submitting proposals that highlight our technical strengths and differentiators

• Collaborating with engineering, operations, sales, procurement and finance to develop commercially competitive bids

• Supporting the sales team with clarifications, follow-ups and customer engagement

• Taking a lead role in reviewing and developing spares proposals across the UK network

• Continuously improving bid processes to drive efficiency and accuracy

What you’ll bring

• Experience in tendering, proposals or commercial coordination

• A technical understanding of rotating equipment (advantageous but not essential)

• Any technical experience within the motor industry or the ability to read and interpret general arrangement (GA) drawings would be a strong advantage

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to manage multiple deadlines

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• High attention to detail and a proactive, customer-focused approach

• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce experience would be beneficial)

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Silver Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an HR Specialist, you will be involved in employee lifecycle administration, HR compliance, recruitment, and broader HR initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to contribute to a culture of excellence and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

• Support HR projects and initiatives, such as performance management cycles, training activities, and employee engagement programs.

• Ensure full compliance with French labor legislation and internal HR standards.

• Assist with end-to-end recruitment and onboarding, including posting job ads, screening CVs, coordinating interviews, and preparing new hire documentation.

• Respond to employee queries related to HR policies, procedures, and benefits.

• Prepare HR reports and analyze workforce data to identify trends and propose improvements.

• Assist with payroll preparation and related administrative processes.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in an HR generalist or specialist role, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Strong understanding of Moroccan labor law and HR best practices.

• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.

• High level of professionalism and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

What we offer you

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits: EID allowance (“prime mouton”), Meal allowance , Retirement contribution

• Healthcare coverage

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

• Potential to increase the contract to full time

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Key Responsibilities
Provide technical support during the sales process.
Conduct product demonstrations and presentations.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams.
Customize solutions based on client requirements.
Assist in proposal development and contract negotiations.
Support post-sales implementation and troubleshooting.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products and technologies.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 5-7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Technical background in engineering or related field.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in solution selling.
Ability to translate technical features into business benefits.
Familiarity with CRM and technical documentation tools.

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bonus over low

• Development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
