jobs.title: Mechanical Design & Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for comprehensive understanding project scope to determine the requirement for developing a Submittal Package. Submittal package includes mechanical design, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and the preparation of mechanical components specific to individual sales orders. The role involves compiling and coordinating the development of Submittal Packages in close collaboration with Motor Control Designers and the ORE Manager. Additionally, this position will manage the submittal approval process with customers, ensuring timely feedback and resolution. Upon approval, the position is accountable for generating fabrication drawings, creating part numbers within the ERP system, and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, the position provides mechanical engineering expertise to Tendering by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Design mechanical components, assemblies, and general arrangement drawings specific to sales orders using Autodesk Inventor and maintain associated files within the Autodesk Vault management system.

• Create and manage submittal packages through the customer approval process, ensuring timely and accurate release.

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and bills of materials (BOMs) prepared by other team members within the ORE department to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Conduct mechanical specification reviews to support tendering activities, as assigned by the ORE Manager.

• Provide mechanical engineering support to other departments as directed by the ORE Manager.

• Assist Production and field service technicians by offering mechanical support during fabrication and product installation.

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience:
Required: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with 2+ years of experience.

Desired: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering and project management professional certification (PMP) with 2+ years of experience.

Skills:
Required:
CAD Experience in 3D modeling and drafting
ERP System Experience.
Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases).

Desired:
Autodesk Inventor
Knowledge of ASME Y 14.5M 2018 standards.

Decision Authority:
Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. This position is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies.

Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to mechanical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for managing the customer submittal approval process and supporting Operations.

Delegation: This position may delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the ORE department, under the guidan

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we help customers keep critical operations running—supporting industries where performance, uptime, and reliability are non-negotiable. Across our global network, we partner with operators in power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors to deliver responsive, high-quality service solutions for gas turbine equipment.

Our Gas Turbine Aero business is known for its agility, customer focus, and ability to deliver when it matters most. We’re a trusted partner across EMEA, helping customers maximise the value of their assets and keep their operations moving. As Area Sales Manager, you’ll take ownership of a diverse and high-potential EMEA territory, with the freedom to shape your approach, target key accounts, and drive growth. If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities, and closing deals in a competitive market—this is your platform to make a real impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Owning and delivering revenue growth across your EMEA territory

• Proactively identifying and converting new business opportunities

• Building strong, lasting relationships with key decision-makers

• Developing and executing account plans and territory strategies

• Leading commercial discussions and negotiating high-value deals

• Maintaining a strong pipeline and delivering consistent results

• Acting as the voice of the customer within the business

What We’re Looking For

• Proven track record in sales within the gas turbine sector (essential)

• Strong commercial mindset with a passion for winning new business

• Experience managing complex, multi-country accounts

• Confident communicator with the ability to influence at all levels

• Self-driven, independent, and comfortable working home-based

• Willingness to travel across the EMEA region

What we offer you

Given the role can be based anywhere across the EMEA region and the candidate is open to travel, we will always look to employ individuals on a local, in‑country contract, with relevant local terms and conditions applied.

Alongside this, you can expect a competitive base salary, an annual bonus scheme linked to both individual and company performance, continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways, and the opportunity to develop your career within a global organisation.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: IT Apprentice (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The IT Jr. Support is responsible for performing basic IT support tasks such as setting up equipment, assisting users, and following standard procedures. This role works under supervision and supports routine IT operations. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with hardware and software setup and configuration.

• Provide basic technical support to users.

• Follow standard procedures for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Maintain IT equipment and workspace organization.

• Escalate issues to senior support staff as needed.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Qualifications

• Basic understanding of IT hardware and software.

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office is a plus.

A requirement is that you will register yourself for the BBL program "ICT Support Technician" or "ICT system engineer" in Nijmegen (ROC), Arnhem (Rijn IJssel), or Breda (Curio). You attend school one day a week and work four days at our company.
Minimum B1 Dutch language level is required.

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

jobs.title: Head Field Service Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Head of the new Field Service Hub in South-West Netherlands, you will develop and manage the Field Service activities and smaller in-house repairs in the workshop as well as the local Field Service team. You will be responsible for the calculation and execution of site commissioning, service and repair jobs including all relevant HSE requirements at customer sites. You will support related warranty complaints and resolutions together with warranty department.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and evaluate customer inquiries, specifications and technical documentation

• Provide technical and commercial support to customers and their projects

• Conduct site visits to assess conditions, safety requirements, and define needed personnel, equipment and tools

• Prepare cost calculations and quotations in the ERP system, including scheduling and coordination of subcontractors and leased personnel

• Support field service activities on site, especially during the initial phase

• Lead, train and develop the local field service team

• Plan and schedule service jobs including internal and external resources

• Define and coordinate services from subcontractors, obtain quotations and manage execution

• Ensure all required documentation is available prior to job execution

• Prepare all relevant documentation for invoicing after completion of field service activities

• Report business activities and customer interactions in the CRM system

• Provide technical support and training to customers and internal stakeholders

• Collaborate closely with local sales teams and the wider service network

• Handle and resolve customer complaints

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with all relevant safety standards

Your Profile

• Solid experience in field service and pump repair

• Experience in leading or coordinating small teams

• Ability to calculate and estimate repair and service jobs

• Knowledge of refinery, petrochemical or power plant environments, especially regarding safety requirements

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT systems (ERP/CRM)

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with a proactive mindset

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Negotiation and influencing skills

• Commercial awareness and understanding of service business

• Intercultural awareness and ability to work in an international environment

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Engineer serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lean Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.

• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.

• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.

• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.

• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.

• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.

• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.

• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.

• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.

• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job title - Mechanical Design Engineer

Main accountabilities and tasks-
• 1.Contribute in the team-work developing detailed solutions within the concept
• 2.Creating CAD models for the product ranges (parts & assemblies)
• 3.Create 3D Models, Manufacturing Drawing for the parts and assemblies
• 4.Generate support documentations from CAD (as applicable) like exploded views, Dim-drawings, P&ID etc.
• 5.Generate pictures from CAD to be used in manuals
• 6.Coordinating and reporting to Sulzer Legal Entities

Desired experience and qualifications
Work experience: 3+ years

Expertise (e.g. professional, technical): Experience in Sheet metal Design, Knowledge of manufacturing methods, limitations, Laser cutting and nesting principles, Welding of sheet metal parts, Understanding of mechanisams: bearings, lubrication, etc.
• Knowledge of Sheet metal modules in CAD (Inventor), Vault. Knowledge of Fusion team will be added advantage.
• Basic knowledge of systematic approach to risk management, like FMEA.
• Capability to make simple strength calculations.
• Good knowledge of GD&T

Education: Level: Bachelor's Degree
Subject: Mechanical Engineering Certifications

Languages: English

Soft skills: Communication Skills, Ability to act independently, Time management, Team work, Analytical and Problem Solving Skills

What we offer you

• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Hospitalization insurance benefit
• Long service award
• Subsidized cafeteria

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Development Engineer is responsible for improving or developing new products, components, equipment, systems, technologies, or processes. This role ensures that research and design methodologies meet scientific and engineering standards and supports the organization in achieving technical, functional, and cost targets.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
The Engineering Tools Group has the responsibility to provide the global engineering departments with software solutions supporting mechanical engineering processes. To complete our team, we are looking for a motivated and committed software developer with experience in web-based applications and data analysis.

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Development of Web Applications from scratch or modification of existing app that includes UI creation/adaption

• Creation of databases and using CRUD operations on them, working knowledge of stored procedures

• Project execution within timeline, requirement collection from mechanical engineers/end users and communication with development team

• Participate in activities such as programing, code review, testing, debugging and code refactoring (ASP.NET CORE / MVC)

• Maintain and enhance software by suggesting and implementing changes based on user feedback and business processes in place or to come.

• Apply agile methodology and software development lifecycle processes.

Additional tasks

• Support maintenance of desktop applications if required

Competencies and behaviour:

• Ability to communicate clearly and efficiently to different levels in the organization

• Customer oriented behaviour

• Organizational and time management skills

• Ability to act independently and proactively

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change

• Attention to detail and understanding of the importance of quality

• Analytical mind, capacity to understand problems and solve them

• Good English skills (written and verbal) required

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor or Master degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science or in Engineering with additional software development experience.

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in web application development with ASP.NET CORE / MVC.

• Solid understanding of modern web development technologies, architecture, and best practices.

• Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and UI libraries such as Bootstrap.

• Experience with MS SQL Server, including database design, queries, and stored procedures.

• Experience in designing and implementing user interfaces based on customer or business requirements.

• Understanding of web services, RESTful APIs, and service-oriented architecture.

• Proficiency in C# and object-oriented programming principles.

• Experience with cloud-based applications is an advantage.

• Familiarity with containerization (Docker) or orchestration (Kubernetes) is beneficial.

• Experience with Python and data analysis is an advantage.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Conducts Sales visits to customers in assigned market

• Reviews the customer request for quotation (RFQ’s) to ensure necessary information is available and that the customer’s requirements conform to the company’s capabilities.

• Responsible for representing Sulzer during the commercial portion of the proposal.

• Determines and recommends the pricing to be included in the quotation to the customer, within established guidelines.

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and to participate in project initiation.

• Presents the proposal/quotation to the customer, including equipment description and specification, pricing, and delivery schedule, and reviews and negotiates necessary revisions with the customer.

• Responds and assists to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance .

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in one of the following engineering disciplines: Chemical / Industrial / Process / Physics

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience with water or water related industries

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in sales/business development

• Ability to interpret customer requirements and to communicate to appropriate personnel

• Analytical capability as required in reviewing, assessing, and interpreting customer requirements and developing responsive design specifications and parameters.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Regional Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group Data & Analytics Sr. Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reports and dashboards, and providing insights to support strategic and operational decisions. This role ensures data accuracy and supports data governance initiatives. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Regional Data Analyst
Job Description | Business Intelligence Team

Sulzer offers a wealth of opportunities to drive your career in the direction you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.
Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team as we accelerate our data transformation across the Services Division. This is a role at the intersection of business intelligence, analytics, and technology — for someone who not only understands what the business needs and translates it into impactful dashboards and analysis, but who actively looks for smarter, faster ways to do it.
We are not looking for someone who waits to be handed a tool. We want someone with a builder mindset — who sees a repetitive process and immediately thinks about how to streamline it, who stays genuinely close to what technology can do, and who brings proposals to the table without being asked.
About the Role

As a Business Intelligence & Data Analyst, you will serve as the bridge between regional business stakeholders and our data ecosystem. You will own dashboard development end-to-end, support data quality and governance, and act as a trusted analytics resource for teams spanning Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain.
Beyond delivery, you will be expected to continuously challenge how things are done — identifying opportunities to leverage emerging tools and technologies to make the team and the business work smarter.
What You Will Be Doing

Dashboard Development & Governance

• Gather and translate business requirements into well-structured, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses

• Develop and maintain dashboards in Qlik Sense, ensuring consistent look, feel, and logic across all BI outputs

• Manage development as a project — define scope, align with stakeholders, meet deadlines, and iterate based on feedback

• Develop a deep understanding of our data ecosystem — sources, structures, and how data flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms

• Ensure all dashboards are self-explanatory, actionable, and require minimal training to use

• Maintain documentation of dashboards, data models, and processes

• Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance forums as a reference point for end-users across the region

Data Quality & Governance

• Proactively identify data quality issues and support the relevant teams to define and implement improvement procedures

Analytics & Insights

• Proactively analyse trends across the region, sub-regions, and product lines to surface relevant business insights

• Serve as the primary analytics resource for the region, supporting teams with complex questions that go beyond standard dashboard views

• Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses — leveraging the best available tools to deliver faster, more thorough insights

• Actively engage with regional and sub-regional management to understand their data requirements and support strategic decisions

• Guide regional ambassadors on how to navigate and use existing dashboards independently

Training & Enablement

• Design and deliver training sessions on effective use of BI dashboards and data tools

• Build a culture of data literacy across the region

• Act as a consultant and help desk contact for dashboard-related questions

Insight Communication

• Support

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mechanical Designer - Full Time - Whitby, Canada

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our FRC team within the Sulzer Pumps division of Sulzer Canada as a Mechanical Designer to help us take FRC to the next level.

Job Description

In this role you will be accountable for:

• Modeling 3D layouts and creating drawing sets for installation and construction of our equipment and products using SolidWorks as well as AutoCAD

• Preparing design concepts, sketches, or models of our equipment for approval

• Consulting with engineers and production staff during manufacturing stage

• Assisting the Applications Team to generate sales equipment and layout drawings

• Preparing and interpreting engineering designs, drawings and specifications as they pertain to our equipment or layouts

• Other duties and special projects as assigned
​
To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience with SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM or a related software package

• Knowledge of SolidWorks modeling, sheet metal design and pipe routing

• Familiarity with data management and revision control

• Proficiency in MS Office (formulas, formatting, Outlook)

• Experience in sheet metal design would be an asset

• Experience with welding would be an asset

• Experience using Autodesk Revit for draft and pre-construction drawings would be an asset

• Knowledge of waste management, or water treatment equipment/industry would be an asset

• Willingness to take occasional criminal record/drug tests for US clients

​If you possess a post-secondary degree or diploma in mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology/technician, drafting, mechanical design or similar discipline, take the next step and make the most of your design skills.

Location: We are based in Whitby, ON, with easy access to Highway 401.
Required: Valid Canadian passport and ability to travel to the US.

What we offer you

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer, committed to the strength of a diverse workforce.

83% of our employees recommend Sulzer as a good place to work - so come and join our story, starting
today

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key Responsibilities include reviewing customer purchase orders & material BOM. Review drawings carefully to determine make or buy depending on costs and schedule. Handle multiple reports as needed to monitor multiple jobs and assist production with schedule. Assist in troubleshooting and basic maintenance. Collaborate with team members to meet production goals. Skills & Qualifications May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role. Basic mechanical and technical skills. Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Familiarity with safety and quality procedures. Willingness to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities:
Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical equipment.
Perform preventive maintenance and document findings.
Replace or fabricate parts as needed.
Maintain tools and ensure safe working conditions.
Collaborate with production teams to minimize downtime.
Train and support junior mechanics.
Follow safety and operational procedures.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.
Strong mechanical aptitude and diagnostic skills.
Experience with industrial machinery and tools.
Ability to read technical manuals and schematics.
Knowledge of safety regulations and maintenance procedures.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Compressors and Expanders
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for provision of technical support to customer, sales & operations in the form of detailed Engineering analysis and design, feasibility study and solutions offering to support growth of repairs, spares, upgrades and retrofits of Centrifugal Compressors and Expanders. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert and manage engineering requests associated to tendering and project execution for Turbo-machinery Services in the region.

• Conduct site equipment inspection, root cause analysis and technical forums to support sales team to identify repairs, upgrades and retrofit opportunities

• Challenge traditional Sulzer thinking to ensure we remain ahead of the competition without taking excessive risk

• Review Technical specifications, provide comments/exceptions, input Technical know-how as required to ensure proposals are technically fit for purpose

• Identify and document areas of technical risk and level of design review associated with Projects at an early Tender stage

• Liaise with oversea Sulzer competence centers, specialist functions (e.g. Aero, welding, rotor-dynamic, C&I, etc) and key sub-contractors to clarify client requirements and ensure technical aspects have been adequately addressed

• Consolidate technical offer and associated technical documentation (e.g. data sheets, calculations, technical bid assessment questionnaires) as necessary to satisfy client's Tender requirements

• Provide an Engineering presence, when required, on customer visits, for assessment, bid clarification, client kick off meetings, project execution etc

• Lead and coordinate the different engineering resources associated to the project for the execution on-time and on budget

• Review ITP, inspection reports, and closing report to ensure upmost quality of the work and deliverables

• Develop guidelines, procedures and work instructions to support continuous improvement of quality of Compressor and Expander Services in Oceania

• Be part of the large Sulzer Services specialist and experts community and Support development of Turbine Services capabilities in the Asia region to support the business growth strategy

• All other duties as relevant to the post

Competencies and behaviour required (what strengths are needed)

• Customer service skills

• Communication skills

• Influencing and persuasion skills

• Time management skills

• Ability to act independently

• Attention to details

• Culture of Continuous improvement

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to different team, culture and environment

Qualifications/Experience Required

• Bachelor or Master in Mechanical Engineering

• 5 years minimum experience in service of Centrifugal Compressors and/or Expanders

• Experience in Oil &Gas, Fertilizers and Petrochemical industry

• Design and drafting skills

• General computer skills

• Analytical skills

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Job Description:

• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.

• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.

• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.

• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system

• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.

• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.

• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request

• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative

• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.

• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.

• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.

• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.

• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop

Requirements:

• Diploma’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment

• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage

• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators

• Fluent in English

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated minset

• Multi-tasking

• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant RTR
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a/an Senior accountant (RTR) to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As a Senior accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key Responsabilities:

• Serve as a key member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Oversees and governs the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis to solve discrepancies

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Provide documentation and explanations for internal and external audits

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English. French is a big plus

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vib

jobs.title: Driver - Class B CDL
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Safely operates trucks requiring a CDL class B license. You will complete customer equipment pick-ups for repair and safely transporting the equipment to the Service Center and then back to the customer. This includes the knowledge of properly securing the load as required by regulation and safely operating large flatbed vehicles amongst the public. Key Responsibilities:

• Performs and safely operates vehicles as required.

• Pick up the customer equipment for repair and safely transporting the equipment to the Service Center and then back to the customer.

• Properly securing the load as required by regulation and safely operating large flatbed vehicles amongst the public.

• Ability to be properly licensed, medically capable and have the knowledge to operate the class of vehicle they will be assigned to drive.

• Support other duties which includes transferring parts from one area to another, cleaning machines and trucks, and other duties as outlined by the Operation Leader to support all and any jobs contracted by Sulzer EMS.

• Must have a current CDL Class B license.

• Must be able to pass a DOT Physical.

• Must be able to read and understand the English language.

• Physical and mental abilities to learn and perform job functions properly and in a timely manner, especially functions affecting the safety of anyone on site.

• Must be 18 or older according to specific State law; 21 or older for Interstate operations.

Additional qualifications:

• Basic understanding of warehouse operations.

• Experience driving a forklift is preferred but not required.

• Ability to follow instructions and standard procedures.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Physical ability to lift and move items.

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

jobs.title: Jr. Procurement Officer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Procurement Officer is responsible for supporting procurement activities including order processing, supplier communication, and documentation. This role assists in ensuring timely and accurate purchasing of goods and services under close supervision. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
• Job Description
• Order parts for jobs promptly, as advised by shop departments.

• Support operations in preparations of quotes and estimates by contacting vendors for budgetary pricing and availability for equipment and materials.

• Maintain a professional attitude when representing the company during phone or personal contact with outside vendors, customers, or service providers, etc.

• Accurately complete material requisitions and purchase orders and enter them into the database.

• Must be able to work in a schedule-driven environment. Timing is a critical function.

• Must be able to manage budgets and avoid delayed costs including shipping.

• Issue purchase orders

• Cost control, change control and scheduling of materials.

• Inventory management – perform cycle counts and reconcile with ERP system.

• Frequently review work in progress (WIP) reports for material needs and delivery times.

• Expediting orders, quotes, backorders, work scope changes, etc.

• Order restock items such as general, consumables, safety, welding, machine tooling, C-stock items and office supplies

• Pick up parts from vendors if needed

• Operates material handling equipment such as pallet jacks, forklifts, dollies and other related equipment.

• Other duties as assigned such as filing; assisting in the office or with special projects.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tendering Estimation Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Tendering Engineer to support proposal development for equipment and services supplied to nuclear power plants. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience working with industrial pumps or strong pump application knowledge, and a solid understanding of tendering processes in highly regulated environments.
This role involves preparing competitive, compliant proposals, coordinating across engineering, procurement, and project teams, and ensuring strict adherence to nuclear industry standards and customer specifications.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and analyze RFQs and customer specifications related to nuclear pump systems

• Prepare technical proposals for pumps and related parts

• Interpret datasheets, and technical drawings to ensure accurate scope definition

• Collaborate with sales, engineering, purchasing, quality, and project management teams to develop compliant bids

• Conduct cost estimation, including materials, labor, manufacturing, and third-party components

• Ensure compliance with nuclear standards (e.g., ASME, RCC-M, ISO, QA requirements)

• Identify risks and opportunities within tender documents and propose mitigation strategies

• Support post-bid clarification meetings and customer discussions

• Maintain tender documentation, bid logs, and lessons learned

• Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools

Qualifications & Experience
Required:

• 3–5 years of experience in pump systems, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.

• Proven experience in technical tendering, proposals, or applications engineering

• Strong knowledge of Nuclear pumps

• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, drawings, cross sections, and datasheets
Preferred:

• Experience supplying equipment to nuclear, power generation, or highly regulated industries

• Familiarity with nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements

• Exposure to ERP/CRM systems and costing tools such as SAP and Salesforce
Technical Skills

• Pump selection, sizing, and application knowledge

• Understanding of materials, hydraulics, and system integration

• Costing and commercial awareness

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Ability to work with technical and commercial documentation

• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Tendering Engineer to support proposal development for equipment and services supplied to nuclear power plants. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience working with industrial pumps or strong pump application knowledge, and a solid understanding of tendering processes in highly regulated environments. This role involves preparing competitive, compliant proposals, coordinating across engineering, procurement, and project teams, and ensuring strict adherence to nuclear industry standards and customer specifications. Key Responsibilities
• Review and analyze RFQs and customer specifications related to nuclear pump systems
• Prepare technical proposals for pumps and related parts
• Interpret datasheets, and technical drawings to ensure accurate scope definition
• Collaborate with sales, engineering, purchasing, quality, and project management teams to develop compliant bids
• Conduct cost estimation, including materials, labor, manufacturing, and third-party components
• Ensure compliance with nuclear standards (e.g., ASME, RCC-M, ISO, QA requirements)
• Identify risks and opportunities within tender documents and propose mitigation strategies
• Support post-bid clarification meetings and customer discussions
• Maintain tender documentation, bid logs, and lessons learned
• Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools Qualifications & Experience Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in pump systems, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.
• Proven experience in technical tendering, proposals, or applications engineering
• Strong knowledge of Nuclear pumps
• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, drawings, cross sections, and datasheets Preferred:
• Experience supplying equipment to nuclear, power generation, or highly regulated industries
• Familiarity with nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
• Exposure to ERP/CRM systems and costing tools such as SAP and Salesforce Technical Skills
• Pump selection, sizing, and application knowledge
• Understanding of materials, hydraulics, and system integration
• Costing and commercial awareness
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Ability to work with technical and commercial documentation
• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines. What we offer you What We Offer You
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes solving complex problems through investigation and analysis. Job Responsibilities

• Manage technical projects from initiation to completion.

• Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets.

• Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.

• Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and at least of 5–7 years of relevant experiencee.

• Strong project management and engineering skills.

• Proficiency in technical documentation and reporting.

• Effective communication and leadership abilities.

• Experience in cross-functional collaboration.

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Assembly Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This role ensures that assembling work complies with safety regulations and supports operational efficiency. Job Responsibilities

• Finish assigned work on time with good quality and high productivity in pump assembly area.

• Familiar and follow up the safety and environment (EHS) regulation in daily work, reporting any potential EHS related risk issues to the supervisor

• Strictly follow up the manufacturing process document and standard working instruction in operation time.

• Document work performed and materials used.

• Collaborate with other technicians and departments.

Qualifications

• At least 3 years working experience in mechanical industry. Familiar with mechanical industry and product.

• Can read machining drawing.

• Able to operate bridge crane is preferred.

• Able to use general measuring tool, e.g. micrometer, dial indicator, caliper and so on.

• Willingness to learn and follow procedures.

• Physical stamina and attention to detail.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Master Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support.. The Role

The Master Scheduler reports to the Planning & Scheduling Manager and is responsible for driving pre-production readiness across the Leeds site. You’ll own the master production schedule, coordinating materials, labour, subcontractors and capacity ahead of manufacturing to ensure everything is in place for efficient execution. Acting as the central link between engineering, procurement, project management and operations, you’ll ensure plans are realistic, aligned and deliverable, setting projects up for the successful delivery of complex, engineer-to-order pump packages.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimise the master production schedule across engineer-to-order pump packages

• Coordinate pre-production planning including materials, labour, subcontract services, and capacity

• Ensure alignment between demand, project timelines, and manufacturing capability

• Work closely with procurement to ensure material availability supports schedule requirements

• Identify and manage constraints, risks, and bottlenecks within the production plan

• Provide clear visibility of schedules, priorities, and delivery risks to stakeholders

• Monitor schedule adherence and drive continuous improvement in planning performance

• Support on-time, in-full delivery through effective cross-functional coordination

About You

• Proven experience in a master scheduling, production planning, or supply chain role within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and scheduling best practices, with SAP experience preferred

• Experience working in a project-based or engineer-to-order environment is beneficial

• Ability to balance competing priorities and manage complex schedules

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Proactive, analytical approach with strong problem-solving capability

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, or similar industries is desirable

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & pr

jobs.title: JM2-Packaging Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Product Engineer reports to Team Leader ORE.

Responsibilities:

• Management of the assigned mechanical design projects from Sales order review stage to handover to production.

• Undertake responsibility for order related design, processing and supporting activities for the assigned product range.

• Review of the customer project design specifications, communication with Sales/Tendering team to transform the customer requirements into product through order related engineering.

• Preparation of the customer facing documents as Pump Cross Section drawings, Pump General Arrangement drawings, P&ID drawings, Wiring diagram etc in 2D or 3D.

• Review and approval of buyout component drawings & documents related to Motor, Coupling, Mechanical Seal & Systems, ARC Valves, Gear box, VFD, Turbine etc.

• Review of the Instruments requirement & co-ordination with Instrumentation team.

• Preparation, check & release of the Bill Of Material (BOM) in SAP ERP.

• Communicate with Customers & sub-suppliers as necessary.

• Support & coordinate with different teams of Operations, Purchase, Sales, Quality & Testing during the complete cycle of the order execution.

• Provide engineering support to pump site commissioning team until successful operation of the equipment supplied.

• Proactively engage & support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement.

Qualification, Experience and Knowledge requirement

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from reputed institute.

• 4-8 years of experience in Centrifugal Pump design field & API standards.

• Must have hands on experience on AutoCAD design software. Experience in Inventor, NX & Team center will be an added advantage.

• Conversant with the use of the SAP ERP tool.

• Independent and proactive with good communication & interpersonal skills.

• Managed and executed multiple tasks while taking direction from several sources.

• High sense of ownership, strong work ethic, focused on details and results oriented.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Operativer Einkäufer (m/w/d) – Technischer Einkauf
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position im operativen Einkauf übernehmen Sie die Beschaffung von technischen Komponenten und komplexen Systemen für unsere Pumpenaggregate.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Einholen und Vergleichen von Angeboten unter technischen und kommerziellen Gesichtspunkten

• Führen von Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen inkl. Übertragung von Kundenvertragsbedingungen

• Analyse von Beschaffungsalternativen und Abstimmung mit Projektmanagement, Technik und Lieferanten

• Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Vergabeverhandlungen

• Abwicklung von Bestellungen und Bestelländerungen unter Berücksichtigung projektbezogener Anforderungen

• Aktives Claims Management gegenüber Lieferanten

• Klärung und Verhandlung von Abweichungen (QM)

• Prüfung und Freigabe von Lieferantenrechnungen

• Kontinuierlicher Ausbau Ihres technischen und marktbezogenen Verständnisses

• Sicherstellung termingerechter Lieferungen im verantworteten Einkaufsbereich

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau mit wirtschaftlichem Bezug)

• oder alternativ eine technische Ausbildung (Techniker/Meister) mit relevanter Berufserfahrung

• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis

• Erfahrung im Einkauf, idealerweise im technischen Umfeld

• Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Sehr gute Systemkenntnisse (MS Office, SAP R/3; idealerweise Meercat)

• Strukturierte und belastbare Arbeitsweise, auch unter Zeitdruck

• Durchsetzungsstärke und Verhandlungsgeschick

What we offer you

• Schlüsselposition mit Verantwortung und direktem Beitrag zum Wachstum

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Ausstattung

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen (u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Familienservice ‑ Hotline)

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
