jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. 1. Preparation and submission of tenders in line with customer requirements, ensuring to meet Sulzer commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the Delegation of Authority.
• 2. Obtain the quotes from sub-vendors for bought outs, outsourcing activities.
• 3. Work closely with Sales, Engineering and Operations to provide cost effective, competitive solutions in line with Sulzer financial objectives.
• 4. Overall responsibility for sustaining the profit margin on tenders.
• 5. Follow up outstanding tenders with customers/sales agents in accordance with agreed Company requirements, and in conjunction with Sales teams.
• 6. Preparation of Lost Bid Analysis.
• 7. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and compliance with policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines.
• 8. Work closely with the Sales teams to meet TCT, extend best support to improve OCT.
• 9. Accurate Order booking in SAP / ZEST in line with the contract, Regularization of order, monitoring and updating status of order to customer to meet CDD, achieve sales target.
• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement.

What we offer you

• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Hospitalization insurance benefit
• On-site car parking
• Long service award

jobs.title: Project Engineer - Services
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end spare order management, planning and execution by reviewing scope, developing detailed schedules, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring delivery within approved budgets and resource constraints, with a focus on achieving more than 95% on-time delivery.

• Monitor, control, and report project performance by tracking orders, managing backlogs, ensuring schedule adherence, and handling spare order management to meet customer and business requirements.

• Identify, assess, and manage risks by implementing proactive mitigation strategies to ensure smooth order execution.

• Manage order budgets, resources, and quality standards while ensuring compliance with applicable organizational requirements, along with maintaining strong control over accounts receivables.

• Establish and maintain effective communication with customers and internal teams to enhance customer satisfaction and support informed decision-making.

• Ensure proper project closure through comprehensive documentation, reporting, and formal handover to relevant stakeholders.

• Apply strategic thinking, problem-solving skills, and innovative approaches to resolve project/order execution challenges.

• Demonstrate strong technical and manufacturing process knowledge to effectively collaborate with engineering, production, and operations teams.

• Good Knowledge about Microsoft Office, hands on experience on MS- Excel and SAP are required

• Exhibit excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Pump, compressor, coupling knowledge would be added advantage.

Skills & Qualifications:.
University degree Batchelor of Engineering ( B.E Mechanical preferred) OR relevant degree and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:
Solid understanding of project management principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong experience in Spares order management
Effective communication and teamwork.
Hands on experience on with MS-Excel, MS Project & SAP
Ability to work independently with general supervision.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Senior Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Senior Pump Mechanic is responsible for the inspection, disassembly, repair, reassembly, balancing, and testing of industrial pumps and rotating equipment in a high-quality service center environment. This role serves as a technical expert for complex repairs, including precision balancing of impellers and assembled rotors, ensuring all work meets OEM specifications, safety standards, and customer requirements. The Senior Pump Mechanic also supports mentoring junior mechanics and contributes to continuous improvement within the repair process. Key Responsibilities

• Perform complete teardown, inspection, and rebuild of centrifugal pumps, multistage pumps, vertical pumps, and other rotating equipment

• Diagnose mechanical issues including wear, imbalance, misalignment, and hydraulic performance problems

• Balance individual components such as impellers as well as fully assembled rotors to meet OEM and industry standards

• Assemble rotating elements including shafts, sleeves, bearings, and impellers with proper fits and tolerances

• Conduct hydrostatic testing on pump cases

• Measure and record tolerances using precision tools (micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, etc.)

• Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and OEM specifications

• Restore pumps to OEM or engineered specifications

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

• Ensure all repairs, assemblies, and balancing activities meet quality standards and customer expectations

• Participate in quality audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications

• 5–10+ years of experience in pump repair or rotating equipment maintenance

• Strong knowledge of centrifugal pumps and rotating assemblies

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications

• Proficiency with precision measuring instruments

• Solid mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Demonstrate willingness and ability to cross-train in multiple work centers

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Turbomachinery Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Designs and delivers hands on mechanical training courses (1–2 weeks) that build foundational and advanced turbomachinery skills, guiding new hires through core concepts, job book exercises, and real-world inspection and assembly practices while evaluating their proficiency. Develops and continuously improves training curricula, materials, and programs to address skill gaps, enhance safety and productivity, and ensure effective onboarding and ongoing workforce upskilling. Responsibilities

• Leading novice mechanical training courses
• Helping to develop the next generation of mechanical talent within our organization
• Guiding groups through the critical job book exercises

• Teaching refined mechanical skills throughout the disassembly, inspection and reassembly stages of an overall

• Verifying an employee’s ability to apply measurement methods to real world inspection scenarios

• Guide new hires through basic terminology and turbomachinery overview

• Identify current and future training needs and create a curriculum to facilitate that training

• Refining and developing mechanical training materials
• Advancing the modules that have already been created

• Building out adjacent training modules for other equipment types

• Developing training aides for specialized tasks.

• Leading periodic advance mechanical upskilling training efforts

• Supporting aspects of new hire shop orientation

• Supporting occasional outage Production Supervision responsibilities/oversight

• Search for gaps in training content and materials that need updating to generate higher productivity and safety among staff

• Researching new training supplies and materials that can enhance Sulzer’s training procedures while providing value to employees

• Communicating with management, trainers, and team members to ensure that all training needs are met

• Conducting technical orientation programs and arranging on-the-job training for new hires as needed

• Resolving any specific problems and tailoring training programs as necessary

• Provide documentation of employees performance during training to supervision and upper management including aptitude, attitude, and academic performance.

• Maintain records from all training classes.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Education, or similar related disciplines and/or a combination of training, experience, and education.

• 5 or more years of technical training experience in an industrial and/or manufacturing setting

• 5 or more years of hands-on turbo machinery maintenance, repair, and/or refurbish experience.

• Significant experience creating technical training curriculums and programs

• Ability to plan, manage time, and multitask effectively

• Advanced database and computer skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Advanced record-keeping skills

• Good decision-making, problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork skills

• Leadership and motivational skills are a plus

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Manager Management
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Management Specialist is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes coaching junior professionals, solving complex problems, and ensuring project success through technical and analytical leadership.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Objetivo del puesto
Asegurar la correcta ejecución de proyectos desde su transferencia por el área de ventas hasta la instalación final y el cierre administrativo, garantizando el cumplimiento del alcance, costos, riesgos, tiempos de entrega (OTD) y satisfacción del cliente.

Responsabilidades principales

• Planificar y coordinar las actividades del proyecto conforme a requerimientos contractuales.

• Mantener el calendario de entregas y dar seguimiento puntual para asegurar cumplimiento en tiempo.

• Asegurar que el alcance de suministro sea preciso, completo y bien definido.

• Establecer comunicación continua con áreas internas y externas (ingeniería, calidad, ventas, compras, fábrica, clientes).

• Identificar riesgos, gestionar cambios y contribuir a mantener o mejorar el margen de utilidad del proyecto.

• Preparar y documentar avances, minutas y reportes del proyecto para las áreas involucradas.

• Reportar incidentes, no conformidades y asegurar el cumplimiento de los estandares QESH.

KPI’s principales

• Margen planificado del proyecto

• Entregas a tiempo

• Garantías de equipo

• Satisfacción del cliente

Requisitos

• Licenciatura en: Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Mecánica, Industrial, Química o afín.

• Experiencia: 7 años en adelante gestionando ejecución de proyectos o roles similares en industria manufacturera.

• Conocimientos en análisis de costos, riesgos, gestión del cambio y atención a clientes.

• Inglés avanzado (leer, hablar, escribir).

• Conocimientos deseables en ingeniería de diseño.

Habilidades y competencias

• Enfoque en resultados y ejecución.

• Gestión de riesgos y seguimiento.

• Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en equipo.

• Interpretación de planos.
Experiencia en metodología SCRUM

• Conocimientos PMI (60 horas).

• Alineación con los principios corporativos: responsabilidad, trabajo en equipo, creación de valor y aprovechamiento de oportunidades.

Software

• SAP (CJ20N, ZPSREP61, VA03, MD4C) – Nivel avanzado

• Microsoft Office – avanzado.

• Project / Planner – avanzado

• M-Files – Intermedio.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos:

• Salario competitivo acorde a experiencia

• Vales de despensa

• Seguro de Gastos médicos mayores

• Fondo de ahorro

• Aguinaldo superior a la ley

• Prestaciones superiores

jobs.title: Test Bed Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees who install, configure, and maintain technical products and systems at customer locations.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Actividades principales

• Realizar pruebas de comportamiento a bombas nuevas o reparadas utilizando un sistema de adquisición de datos, así como instrumentación e instalación del banco de pruebas para certificar que las bombas cumplen por lo requerido por el cliente y normas aplicables.

• Analizar los resultados de prueba comparando contra lo requerido por el cliente y las normas aplicables para determinar si las bombas están dentro o fuera de lo especificado.

• Realizar los certificados de pruebas de comportamiento utilizando hoja de cálculo, así como el sistema PumpJob para su envío a cliente.

• Registrar cada prueba de comportamiento realizada en banco de pruebas para llevar una estadística.

• Enviar los certificados de prueba a cliente utilizando el sistema SAP para su aprobación.

• Escanear y archivar los requerimientos hidráulicos utilizando el sistema SAP para dejar registrado que requerimientos necesita la bomba para operar correctamente.

Requisitos:

• Conocimientos en Hidráulica.

• Selección, operación y mantenimiento de Equipos de Bombeo.

• Conocimiento en vibraciones mecánicas.

• Manejo de AutoCAD, MS Office

• Experiencia en diseño de bombas centrifugas, manejo de NX para dibujo

• Comprensión y adaptabilidad a innovaciones tecnológicas aplicables a la Hidráulica (equipo, instrumentos y Software)

• Amplio conocimiento de Norma API, HIS, ISO

• Inglés Intermedio/Avanzado

• Salario acorde a experiencia

• Aguinaldo superior

• Gastos médicos mayores

• Vales de despensa

jobs.title: Helper
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Helper role to support different shop departments as needed. PHOENIX, ARIZONA

REPORTS TO:
Assigned Department Manager or designee ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
o High school diploma or equivalent

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
· While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
· Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave

401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program
